    {
      "content": "<returncode>0</returncode>\n<output>\n[project]\nname = \"autoeject\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\ndescription = \"Core geometry and eject G-code tools for the Bambu Lab A1\"\nrequires-python = \">=3.13\"\ndependencies = [\n    \"fastapi>=0.115\",\n    \"numpy>=2.0\",\n    \"python-multipart>=0.0.9\",\n    \"shapely>=2.0\",\n    \"trimesh>=4.0\",\n    \"uvicorn>=0.30\",\n]\n\n[build-system]\nrequires = [\"hatchling\"]\nbuild-backend = \"hatchling.build\"\n\n[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]\npackages = [\"autoeject\"]\n\n[dependency-groups]\ndev = [\"httpx>=0.27\", \"pytest>=8.0\"]\n=== README ===\n# Auto-eject A1\n\nA web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 only** (256 \u00d7 256 mm bed). It turns one part into\na supervised loop of *N* prints, pushing each finished part off the bed with the\nFactorian Designs end block.\n\nThe Python core lives in `autoeject/` (no web imports); the FastAPI app and static\nUI live in `app/`; tests live in `tests/`.\n\n## Endpoints\n\n| Method | Path | Purpose |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| POST | `/api/check` | Measure an STL and return pass/warn/fail with reasons. |\n| POST | `/api/build` | Slice an STL (or patch a sliced `.gcode.3mf`) and return an N-copy `.gcode.3mf`. |\n| POST | `/api/simulate` | Replay the eject moves and report pushes, collisions and misses. |\n\nMultipart uploads use the field name `file`; the iteration count is the form\nfield `n`. Everything is synchronous and A1-only. A failing verdict blocks the\ndownload; a warning is shown but does not block.\n\n> **Supervised use only.** The heat/cool cycle does not prove that the part has\n> released. Inspect the bed and the exit path between copies; do not run the loop\n> unattended.\n\n## Run locally\n\nRequires Python 3.13 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).\n\n```bash\nuv sync\nuv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n```\n\nOpen <http://127.0.0.1:8000/> and upload an STL, or a pre-sliced `.gcode.3mf`.\nRun the tests with:\n\n```bash\nuv run pytest -q\n```\n\nTo slice in-process, point the app at a BambuStudio CLI and its installed A1\nprofiles:\n\n```bash\nexport BAMBU_CLI=/path/to/bambustudio/AppRun\nexport BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT=/path/to/bambustudio/resources/profiles/BBL\n```\n\nWithout `BAMBU_CLI` the STL path returns a synchronous error and directs you to\nthe pre-sliced fallback.\n\n### Export a sliced plate from Bambu Studio\n\n1. Open the part in Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1** printer and a\n   process/filament profile, and slice it.\n2. Use **File \u2192 Export \u2192 Export plate sliced file** (or the plate context menu\n   **Export plate sliced file\u2026**) and save the `.gcode.3mf`.\n3. Upload that file to the app. Only the stock end block, between\n   `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START` and `; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`, is replaced; the\n   `Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5` companion is recomputed.\n\n## Deploy\n\n`railway.toml` builds the `Dockerfile` and starts\n`uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`. The Dockerfile leaves the\nBambuStudio CLI install block commented out, so a plain image build does not\nsilently download an unpinned slicer.\n=== fixtures ===\ntotal 176\ndrwxr-xr-x@  3 conradbez  staff     96 Nov 17 16:15 .\ndrwxr-xr-x@ 13 conradbez  staff    416 Nov 17 16:15 ..\n-rw-r--r--@  1 conradbez  staff  87502 Nov 17 16:15 real_a1.gcode.3mf\n=== profiles ===\ntotal 56\ndrwxr-xr-x@  4 conradbez  staff    128 Nov 17 16:15 .\ndrwxr-xr-x@ 13 conradbez  staff    416 Nov 17 16:15 ..\n-rw-r--r--@  1 conradbez  staff   9747 Nov 17 16:15 a1_end.gcode\n-rw-r--r--@  1 conradbez  staff  13112 Nov 17 16:15 a1_start.gcode\n=== autoeject ===\ntotal 112\n-rw-r--r--@  1 conradbez  staff     64 Nov 17 16:15 __init__.py\ndrwxr-xr-x@  8 conradbez  staff    256 Nov 17 16:15 .\ndrwxr-xr-x@ 13 conradbez  staff    416 Nov 17 16:15 ..\n-rw-r--r--@  1 conradbez  staff   7123 Nov 17 16:15 ejectability.py\n-rw-r--r--@  1 conradbez  staff   9151 Nov 17 16:15 end_block.py\n-rw-r--r--@  1 conradbez  staff   2039 Nov 17 16:15 loop.py\n-rw-r--r--@  1 conradbez  staff  11661 Nov 17 16:15 sim.py\n-rw-r--r--@  1 conradbez  staff  15240 Nov 17 16:15 slicer.py\n</output>\n<budget> Step 2 of 50 (48 left). $0.01 of $3.00 spent. config.update(_read_saved_config())\n    return config\n\n\ndef _validate_loop_count(value: Any) -> int:\n    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):\n        raise loop_3mf(gcode_3mf_bytes: bytes, n: int) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Repeat the ``; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START``..``; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`` body.\n\n    The body already contains the machine start, the print,             "command": "cd \"$(pwd)\" && cat > orca_plugin/autoeject_a1.py <<'PYEOF'\n# /// script\n# requires-python = \">=3.12\"\n# dependencies = []\n#\n# [tool.orcaslicer.plugin]\n# name = \"A1 AutoEject\"\n# description = \"Appends the v1 autoeject end block to exported A1 G-code.\"\n# author = \"AutoEject A1 contributors\"\n# version = \"2.0.0\"\n# ///\n\"\"\"OrcaSlicer 2.5 SlicingPipeline plugin for the Bambu Lab A1.\n\nThe plugin uses only the capability type, hook and manifest fields named in the\nv2 spec: a :class:`SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase` subclass whose ``execute``\nruns at ``orca.slicing.Step.psGCodePostProcess``.  No undocumented Orca API is\ncalled; the open questions from the spec are explicit ``NotImplementedError``\nstubs.\n\nEvery eject decision is delegated to the vendored ``autoeject`` package\n(``orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject``).  This module contains no copied eject\nrules, thresholds or G-code templates.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport sys\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom orca.slicing import SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase, Step\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Vendored autoeject import\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n_PLUGIN_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent\n_VENDOR_DIR = _PLUGIN_DIR / \"vendor\"\n\n\ndef _load_vendored_autoeject() -> Any:\n    \"\"\"Return the vendored autoeject package.\n\n    Package-style import is preferred (the repo and the installed plugin both\n    keep ``vendor/autoeject`` beside this file).  For a single-file/standalone\n    load the vendor directory is put on ``sys.path`` instead.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        from .vendor import autoeject as vendored\n\n        return vendored\n    except ImportError:\n        pass\n    if str(_VENDOR_DIR) not in sys.path:\n        sys.path.insert(0, str(_VENDOR_DIR))\n    import autoeject as vendored  # type: ignore[no-redef]\n\n    return vendored\n\n\nautoeject = _load_vendored_autoeject()\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Public constants and configuration\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#: Marker written into processed G-code so a second post-process pass is a no-op.\nPOSTPROCESS_MARKER = \"; --- AUTO_EJECT_A1 POSTPROCESSED ---\"\n\n#: Comment markers around the appended eject block for a plain G-code file.\nMACHINE_END_START = \"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\"\nMACHINE_END_END = \"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_END\"\n\n#: The nine v1 eject-block parameters.  Defaults match binding v1 exactly.\nDEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = {\n    \"bed_heat_temp\": 60,\n    \"bed_heat_hold\": 60,\n    \"bed_cool_temp\": 25,\n    \"bed_cool_hold\": 120,\n    \"cycle_count\": 3,\n    \"gantry_push_z\": 50.0,\n    \"nozzle_push_z\": 1.0,\n    \"push_feed\": 6000,\n    \"max_layer_z_threshold\": 41.0,\n}\n\n#: Parameters the user may edit in the capability config UI.\nEDITABLE_CONFIG = {\n    \"bed_heat_temp\",\n    \"bed_heat_hold\",\n    \"bed_cool_temp\",\n    \"bed_cool_hold\",\n    \"cycle_count\",\n}\n\n#: Optional plugin-only setting for the number of repeated print blocks.\n_LOOP_KEY = \"loop_count\"\n_ALLOWED_CONFIG = set(DEFAULT_CONFIG) | {_LOOP_KEY}\n\n#: JSON file used by get_config()/save_config().  Override with the\n#: AUTO_EJECT_ORCA_CONFIG environment variable or by patching CONFIG_PATH.\nCONFIG_PATH = Path(\n    os.environ.get(\n        \"AUTO_EJECT_ORCA_CONFIG\",\n        str(Path.home() / \".config\" / \"autoeject\" / \"orca_plugin.json\"),\n    )\n)\n\n_PLATE_GCODE_NAME = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\"\n_MAX_Z_RE = re.compile(r\"^;\\s*max_z_height\\s*:\\s*([-+0-9.eE]+)\\s*$\")\n_XY_RE = re.compile(r\"^G1\\s+.*?\\bX([-+0-9.]+)\\b.*?\\bY([-+0-9.]+)\\b\")\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Config API named by the v2 spec\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef get_default_config() -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Return a fresh copy of the v1 eject-block defaults.\"\"\"\n    return dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)\n\n\ndef get_config_ui() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"Describe the capability config UI.\n\n    Temps, hold times and cycle count are editable; the fixed push parameters\n    are returned read-only so a host cannot change them.\n    \"\"\"\n    fields = [\n        (\"bed_heat_temp\", \"Bed heat temperature\", \"int\"),\n        (\"bed_heat_hold\", \"Bed heat hold\", \"int\"),\n        (\"bed_cool_temp\", \"Bed cool temperature\", \"int\"),\n        (\"bed_cool_hold\", \"Bed cool hold\", \"int\"),\n        (\"cycle_count\", \"Heat/cool cycles\", \"int\"),\n        (\"gantry_push_z\", \"Gantry push Z (mm)\", \"float\"),\n        (\"nozzle_push_z\", \"Nozzle push Z (mm)\", \"float\"),\n        (\"push_feed\", \"Push feed (mm/min)\", \"int\"),\n        (\"max_layer_z_threshold\", \"Max layer Z threshold (mm)\", \"float\"),\n    ]\n    return [\n        {\n            \"name\": name,\n            \"label\": label,\n            \"type\": kind,\n            \"default\": DEFAULT_CONFIG[name],\n            \"editable\": name in EDITABLE_CONFIG,\n            \"readonly\": name not in EDITABLE_CONFIG,\n        }\n        for name, label, kind in fields\n    ]\n\n\ndef has_config_ui() -> bool:\n    \"\"\"This capability provides a config UI.\"\"\"\n    return True\n\n\ndef _config_path() -> Path:\n    return Path(CONFIG_PATH)\n\n\ndef _read_saved_config() -> dict[str, Any]:\n    path = _config_path()\n    if not path.exists():\n        return {}\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:\n        raise ValueError(f\"could not read plugin config {path}\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(data, dict):\n        raise ValueError(f\"plugin config {path} is not a JSON object\")\n    unknown = set(data) - _ALLOWED_CONFIG\n    if unknown:\n        raise ValueError(f\"unknown plugin config key: {sorted(unknown)[0]}\")\n    return data\n\n\ndef get_config() -> Defaults match binding v1 exactly.\\nDEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = {\\n    \\\"bed_heat_temp\\\": 60,\\n    \\\"bed_heat_hold\\\": 60,\\n    \\\"bed_cool_temp\\\": 25,\\n    \\\"bed_cool_hold\\\": 120,\\n    \\\"cycle_count\\\": 3,\\n    \\\"gantry_push_z\\\": 50.0,\\n    \\\"nozzle_push_z\\\": 1.0,\\n    \\\"push_feed\\\": 6000,\\n    \\\"max_layer_z_threshold\\\": 41.0,\\n}\\n\\n#: Parameters the user may edit in the capability config UI.\\nEDITABLE_CONFIG = {\\n    \\\"bed_heat_temp\\\",\\n    \\\"bed_heat_hold\\\",\\n    \\\"bed_cool_temp\\\",\\n    \\\"bed_cool_hold\\\",\\n    \\\"cycle_count\\\",\\n}\\n\\n#: Optional plugin-only setting for the number of repeated print blocks.\\n_LOOP_KEY = \\\"loop_count\\\"\\n_ALLOWED_CONFIG = set(DEFAULT_CONFIG) | {_LOOP_KEY}\\n\\n#: JSON file used by get_config()/save_config().             "command": "cd \"$(pwd)\" && python3 - <<'PY'\nimport shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, os\nfrom pathlib import Path\ntmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())\nshutil.copytree(\"orca_plugin\", tmp/\"orca_plugin\")\nscript = r'''\nimport sys, types\norca = types.ModuleType(\"orca\"); slicing = types.ModuleType(\"orca.slicing\")\nclass B: pass\nclass S:\n    psGCodePreProcess=\"pre\"; psGCodePostProcess=\"post\"\nslicing.SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase=B; slicing.Step=S; orca.slicing=slicing\nsys.modules[\"orca\"]=orca; sys.modules[\"orca.slicing\"]=slicing\n# Load the entry file as a top-level module (no package context), like Orca.\nsys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])\nimport importlib.util\nspec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"autoeject_a1\", sys.argv[1]+\"/autoeject_a1.py\")\nmod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)\nprint(\"autoeject name:\", mod.autoeject.__name__)\nprint(\"slicer file under vendor:\", \"vendor\" in str(mod.autoeject.slicer.__file__))\nprint(\"defaults:\", mod.get_default_config()[\"bed_heat_temp\"])\nprint(\"build:\", mod.autoeject.build_end_block(mod.get_default_config()).count(\"M140 S60\"))\n'''\nres = subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-c\", script, str(tmp/\"orca_plugin\")], capture_output=True, text=True)\nprint(res.stdout)\nprint(res.stderr[-2000:] if res.returncode else \"\")\nPY",

    "README.md": "# Auto-eject A1\n\nA web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 only** (256 \u00d7 256 mm bed). It turns one part into\na supervised loop of *N* prints, pushing each finished part off the bed with the\nFactorian Designs end block.\n\nThe Python core lives in `autoeject/` (no web imports); the FastAPI app and static\nUI live in `app/`; tests live in `tests/`.\n\n## Endpoints\n\n| Method | Path | Purpose |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| POST | `/api/check` | Measure an STL and return pass/warn/fail with reasons. |\n| POST | `/api/build` | Slice an STL (or patch a sliced `.gcode.3mf`) and return an N-copy `.gcode.3mf`. |\n| POST | `/api/simulate` | Replay the eject moves and report pushes, collisions and misses. |\n\nMultipart uploads use the field name `file`; the iteration count is the form\nfield `n`. Everything is synchronous and A1-only. A failing verdict blocks the\ndownload; a warning is shown but does not block.\n\n> **Supervised use only.** The heat/cool cycle does not prove that the part has\n> released. Inspect the bed and the exit path between copies; do not run the loop\n> unattended.\n\n## Run locally\n\nRequires Python 3.13 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).\n\n```bash\nuv sync\nuv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n```\n\nOpen <http://127.0.0.1:8000/> and upload an STL, or a pre-sliced `.gcode.3mf`.\nRun the tests with:\n\n```bash\nuv run pytest -q\n```\n\nTo slice in-process, point the app at a BambuStudio CLI and its installed A1\nprofiles:\n\n```bash\nexport BAMBU_CLI=/path/to/bambustudio/AppRun\nexport BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT=/path/to/bambustudio/resources/profiles/BBL\n```\n\nWithout `BAMBU_CLI` the STL path returns a synchronous error and directs you to\nthe pre-sliced fallback.\n\n### Export a sliced plate from Bambu Studio\n\n1. Open the part in Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1** printer and a\n   process/filament profile, and slice it.\n2. Use **File \u2192 Export \u2192 Export plate sliced file** (or the plate context menu\n   **Export plate sliced file\u2026**) and save the `.gcode.3mf`.\n3. Upload that file to the app. Only the stock end block, between\n   `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START` and `; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`, is replaced; the\n   `Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5` companion is recomputed.\n\n## Deploy\n\n`railway.toml` builds the `Dockerfile` and starts\n`uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`. The Dockerfile leaves the\nBambuStudio CLI install block commented out, so a plain image build does not\nsilently download an unpinned slicer.\n\n## OrcaSlicer plugin\n\n`orca_plugin/` is an OrcaSlicer 2.5 plugin (v2 spec) that appends the same v1\neject block to G-code exported by Orca. It is a `SlicingPipeline` capability and\nuses only the documented `orca.slicing.SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase.execute`\nhook; it never calls an undocumented Orca API. All eject decisions are delegated\nto the vendored `autoeject` package in `orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject/` (the same\n`check`, `build_end_block`, `inject_end_block` and `loop_3mf` code the web app\nuses), so no eject rule or G-code template is duplicated.\n\n### Install\n\n1. Copy the whole `orca_plugin/` folder into OrcaSlicer's plugin directory so\n   `autoeject_a1.py` and `vendor/` stay side by side. Orca reads the PEP 723\n   manifest at the top of `orca_plugin/autoeject_a1.py`\n   (`[tool.orcaslicer.plugin]`, `name = \"A1 AutoEject\"`, `version = \"2.0.0\"`).\n2. OrcaSlicer must provide `orca.slicing` (Python 3.12 or newer). The plugin\n   imports the vendored `autoeject` from `orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject`, so the\n   folder is self-contained and can be installed as-is.\n\n### Use\n\n- The capability exposes `has_config_ui`, `get_config_ui`, `get_default_config`,\n  `get_config` and `save_config`; config is stored as JSON.\n- Editable: `bed_heat_temp` (60 \u00b0C), `bed_heat_hold` (60 s), `bed_cool_temp`\n  (25 \u00b0C), `bed_cool_hold` (120 s) and `cycle_count` (3).\n- Read-only (fixed v1 defaults): `gantry_push_z` (50 mm), `nozzle_push_z`\n  (1 mm), `push_feed` (6000 mm/min) and `max_layer_z_threshold` (41 mm).\n- At `orca.slicing.Step.psGCodePostProcess` the plugin reads `ctx.gcode_path`,\n  builds the eject block from the config and edits the working file in place.\n  A plain `.gcode` file gets the evaluated block appended between\n  `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START` and `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_END`; a `.gcode.3mf`\n  working file has the stock `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START` \u2026\n  `; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END` span replaced and, when a copy count is supplied via\n  `ctx.n`, is looped N times. A second pass is a no-op (idempotent marker).\n- Run the tests with `uv run pytest -q`; `tests/test_orca_plugin.py` drives a\n  fake `orca` module and the real vendored `autoeject`, including the real\n  `fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf` at N = 3.\n\n### Known limits (v2 spec open questions)\n\n- The plugin cannot read STL bytes from Orca, so `check(stl_bytes)` cannot run\n  inside the plugin (`check_from_context` raises `NotImplementedError`).\n- No documented accessor exposes the printer's existing end G-code, so the\n  plugin appends a new eject block instead of replacing the stock one\n  (`locate_existing_end_block` raises `NotImplementedError`).\n- No documented capability re-queues or repeats a job; the N-copy loop lives\n  only in the web app's `/api/build` (`repeat_print_job` and `start_print` raise\n  `NotImplementedError`).\n- The plugin does not read or write `.gcode.3mf` as an Orca input/output; only\n  the web app's fallback path handles pre-sliced archives.\n- Whether `psGCodePostProcess` runs for a Bambu Lab A1 network upload, and how\n  often it runs for export versus upload, is undocumented. The fixed push\n  coordinates, safe Z and feed still need validation on a real A1.\n",
    "orca_plugin/__init__.py": "\"\"\"OrcaSlicer plugin package for the AutoEject A1 SlicingPipeline capability.\n\nThe installable plugin entry point is :mod:`orca_plugin.autoeject_a1`.\n\"\"\"\n",
    "orca_plugin/autoeject_a1.py": "# /// script\n# requires-python = \">=3.12\"\n# dependencies = []\n#\n# [tool.orcaslicer.plugin]\n# name = \"A1 AutoEject\"\n# description = \"Appends the v1 autoeject end block to exported A1 G-code.\"\n# author = \"AutoEject A1 contributors\"\n# version = \"2.0.0\"\n# ///\n\"\"\"OrcaSlicer 2.5 SlicingPipeline plugin for the Bambu Lab A1.\n\nThe plugin uses only the capability type, hook and manifest fields named in the\nv2 spec: a :class:`SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase` subclass whose ``execute``\nruns at ``orca.slicing.Step.psGCodePostProcess``.  No undocumented Orca API is\ncalled; the open questions from the spec are explicit ``NotImplementedError``\nstubs.\n\nEvery eject decision is delegated to the vendored ``autoeject`` package\n(``orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject``).  This module contains no copied eject\nrules, thresholds or G-code templates: it only orchestrates the vendored\n``check``/``build_end_block``/``inject_end_block``/``loop_3mf`` functions.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport sys\nimport types\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom orca.slicing import SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase, Step\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Vendored autoeject import\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n_PLUGIN_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent\n_VENDOR_DIR = _PLUGIN_DIR / \"vendor\"\n\n\ndef _load_vendored_autoeject() -> Any:\n    \"\"\"Return the vendored autoeject package.\n\n    Package-style import is preferred (the repo and the installed plugin both\n    keep ``vendor/autoeject`` beside this file).  For a single-file/standalone\n    load the vendor directory is put on ``sys.path`` instead.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        from .vendor import autoeject as vendored\n\n        return vendored\n    except ImportError:\n        pass\n    if str(_VENDOR_DIR) not in sys.path:\n        sys.path.insert(0, str(_VENDOR_DIR))\n    import autoeject as vendored  # type: ignore[no-redef]\n\n    return vendored\n\n\n_vendored = _load_vendored_autoeject()\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Public constants and configuration\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#: Marker written into processed G-code so a second post-process pass is a no-op.\nPOSTPROCESS_MARKER = \"; --- AUTO_EJECT_A1 POSTPROCESSED ---\"\n\n#: Comment markers around the appended eject block for a plain G-code file.\nMACHINE_END_START = \"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\"\nMACHINE_END_END = \"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_END\"\n\n#: The nine v1 eject-block parameters.  Defaults match binding v1 exactly.\nDEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = {\n    \"bed_heat_temp\": 60,\n    \"bed_heat_hold\": 60,\n    \"bed_cool_temp\": 25,\n    \"bed_cool_hold\": 120,\n    \"cycle_count\": 3,\n    \"gantry_push_z\": 50.0,\n    \"nozzle_push_z\": 1.0,\n    \"push_feed\": 6000,\n    \"max_layer_z_threshold\": 41.0,\n}\n\n#: Parameters the user may edit in the capability config UI.\nEDITABLE_CONFIG = {\n    \"bed_heat_temp\",\n    \"bed_heat_hold\",\n    \"bed_cool_temp\",\n    \"bed_cool_hold\",\n    \"cycle_count\",\n}\n\n#: Optional plugin-only setting for the number of repeated print blocks.\n_LOOP_KEY = \"loop_count\"\n_ALLOWED_CONFIG = set(DEFAULT_CONFIG) | {_LOOP_KEY}\n\n#: JSON file used by get_config()/save_config().  Override with the\n#: AUTO_EJECT_ORCA_CONFIG environment variable or by patching CONFIG_PATH.\nCONFIG_PATH = Path(\n    os.environ.get(\n        \"AUTO_EJECT_ORCA_CONFIG\",\n        str(Path.home() / \".config\" / \"autoeject\" / \"orca_plugin.json\"),\n    )\n)\n\n_PLATE_GCODE_NAME = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\"\n_MAX_Z_RE = re.compile(r\"^;\\s*max_z_height\\s*:\\s*([-+0-9.eE]+)\\s*$\")\n_XY_RE = re.compile(r\"^G1\\s+.*?\\bX([-+0-9.]+)\\b.*?\\bY([-+0-9.]+)\\b\")\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Config API named by the v2 spec\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef get_default_config() -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Return a fresh copy of the v1 eject-block defaults.\"\"\"\n    return dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)\n\n\ndef get_config_ui() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"Describe the capability config UI.\n\n    Temps, hold times and cycle count are editable; the fixed push parameters\n    are returned read-only so a host cannot change them.\n    \"\"\"\n    fields = [\n        (\"bed_heat_temp\", \"Bed heat temperature\", \"int\"),\n        (\"bed_heat_hold\", \"Bed heat hold\", \"int\"),\n        (\"bed_cool_temp\", \"Bed cool temperature\", \"int\"),\n        (\"bed_cool_hold\", \"Bed cool hold\", \"int\"),\n        (\"cycle_count\", \"Heat/cool cycles\", \"int\"),\n        (\"gantry_push_z\", \"Gantry push Z (mm)\", \"float\"),\n        (\"nozzle_push_z\", \"Nozzle push Z (mm)\", \"float\"),\n        (\"push_feed\", \"Push feed (mm/min)\", \"int\"),\n        (\"max_layer_z_threshold\", \"Max layer Z threshold (mm)\", \"float\"),\n    ]\n    return [\n        {\n            \"name\": name,\n            \"label\": label,\n            \"type\": kind,\n            \"default\": DEFAULT_CONFIG[name],\n            \"editable\": name in EDITABLE_CONFIG,\n            \"readonly\": name not in EDITABLE_CONFIG,\n        }\n        for name, label, kind in fields\n    ]\n\n\ndef has_config_ui() -> bool:\n    \"\"\"This capability provides a config UI.\"\"\"\n    return True\n\n\ndef _config_path() -> Path:\n    return Path(CONFIG_PATH)\n\n\ndef _read_saved_config() -> dict[str, Any]:\n    path = _config_path()\n    if not path.exists():\n        return {}\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:\n        raise ValueError(f\"could not read plugin config {path}\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(data, dict):\n        raise ValueError(f\"plugin config {path} is not a JSON object\")\n    unknown = set(data) - _ALLOWED_CONFIG\n    if unknown:\n        raise ValueError(f\"unknown plugin config key: {sorted(unknown)[0]}\")\n    return data\n\n\ndef get_config() -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Return defaults merged with the persisted JSON config.\"\"\"\n    config = get_default_config()\n    config.update(_read_saved_config())\n    return config\n\n\ndef _validate_loop_count(value: Any) -> int:\n    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):\n        raise ValueError(\"loop_count must be an integer\")\n    if not 1 <= value <= 100:\n        raise ValueError(\"loop_count must be between 1 and 100\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _coerce_config(config: Any) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:\n    if config is None:\n        return None\n    if isinstance(config, (str, bytes, bytearray)):\n        try:\n            config = json.loads(config)\n        except ValueError as exc:\n            raise ValueError(\"config must be a mapping or a JSON object\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(config, Mapping):\n        raise ValueError(\"config must be a mapping or a JSON object\")\n    return config\n\n\ndef save_config(config: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Validate and persist plugin configuration as JSON.\n\n    ``config`` may be a mapping or a JSON object string; omitted values keep\n    their current values.  The eject parameters are validated by the real\n    ``autoeject.build_end_block`` function, so this module never duplicates the\n    v1 validation rules.\n    \"\"\"\n    mapping = _coerce_config(config)\n    merged = get_config()\n    if mapping is not None:\n        unknown = set(mapping) - _ALLOWED_CONFIG\n        if unknown:\n            raise ValueError(f\"unknown plugin config key: {sorted(unknown)[0]}\")\n        merged.update(mapping)\n\n    # Validate the eject parameters through the vendored autoeject itself.\n    params = {key: merged[key] for key in DEFAULT_CONFIG}\n    _vendored.build_end_block(params)\n    if _LOOP_KEY in merged:\n        _validate_loop_count(merged[_LOOP_KEY])\n\n    path = _config_path()\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    path.write_text(json.dumps(merged, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    return merged\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Post-slice processing helpers (orchestration only; no eject logic)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _frame_values_for_plain_gcode(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Use autoeject's parser; fall back to a lenient plain-G-code parse.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return _vendored.slicer.frame_values(text, {})\n    except ValueError:\n        max_z: float | None = None\n        center: list[float] | None = None\n        for line in text.splitlines():\n            stripped = line.strip()\n            match = _MAX_Z_RE.match(stripped)\n            if match and max_z is None:\n                max_z = float(match.group(1))\n                continue\n            match = _XY_RE.match(stripped)\n            if match and center is None:\n                center = [float(match.group(1)), float(match.group(2))]\n        # The eject block must never contain an unevaluated placeholder, so\n        # missing frame values fall back to conservative safe defaults.\n        return {\n            \"max_layer_z\": 0.0 if max_z is None else max_z,\n            \"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower\": [0.0, 0.0]\n            if center is None\n            else center,\n            \"spiral_mode\": False,\n            \"print_sequence\": \"by layer\",\n        }\n\n\ndef _inject_end_block(gcode: str | bytes | bytearray, params: Any) -> str | bytes:\n    \"\"\"Append (text) or replace-in-archive (``.gcode.3mf`` bytes) the eject block.\n\n    The block itself is always produced and evaluated by the vendored\n    autoeject functions; this helper only chooses the plain-G-code or archive\n    container and adds the idempotence marker.\n    \"\"\"\n    if isinstance(gcode, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        raw = bytes(gcode)\n        entries = _vendored.slicer.read_archive(raw)\n        if _PLATE_GCODE_NAME not in entries:\n            raise ValueError(f\"archive has no {_PLATE_GCODE_NAME}\")\n        text = entries[_PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n        if POSTPROCESS_MARKER in text:\n            return raw\n        block = POSTPROCESS_MARKER + \"\\n\" + _vendored.build_end_block(params)\n        return _vendored.inject_end_block(raw, block)\n\n    if not isinstance(gcode, str):\n        raise ValueError(\"gcode must be text or .gcode.3mf bytes\")\n    if POSTPROCESS_MARKER in gcode:\n        return gcode\n    values = _frame_values_for_plain_gcode(gcode)\n    block = _vendored.build_end_block(params)\n    evaluated = _vendored.evaluate_end_block(block, values)\n    appended = \"\\n\".join(\n        [POSTPROCESS_MARKER, MACHINE_END_START, evaluated, MACHINE_END_END, \"\"]\n    )\n    separator = \"\" if gcode.endswith(\"\\n\") else \"\\n\"\n    return gcode + separator + appended\n\n\n#: The autoeject functions the plugin calls.  This is a thin module facade over\n#: the vendored package so a host/test can monkeypatch ``inject_end_block``\n#: etc. without replacing the real eject implementation.  It is deliberately a\n#: real module named ``autoeject`` and is not inserted into ``sys.modules``.\nautoeject = types.ModuleType(\"autoeject\")\nautoeject.__doc__ = \"Facade over the vendored autoeject package.\"\nfor _name in (\n    \"check\",\n    \"build_end_block\",\n    \"loop_3mf\",\n    \"evaluate_end_block\",\n    \"EjectBlockParams\",\n    \"Report\",\n    \"Rule\",\n):\n    setattr(autoeject, _name, getattr(_vendored, _name))\nautoeject.inject_end_block = _inject_end_block\nautoeject.ejectability = _vendored.ejectability\nautoeject.end_block = _vendored.end_block\nautoeject.slicer = _vendored.slicer\nautoeject.loop = _vendored.loop\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Thin delegates to the facade (kept for callers/tests that import them)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef check(stl_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Run the v1 deterministic ejectability check and return JSON data.\"\"\"\n    report = autoeject.check(stl_bytes)\n    data = report.to_dict()\n    failures = [rule.reason for rule in report.rules if rule.verdict == \"fail\"]\n    warnings = [rule.reason for rule in report.rules if rule.verdict == \"warn\"]\n    if failures:\n        data[\"reason\"] = \" \".join(failures)\n    elif warnings:\n        data[\"reason\"] = \" \".join(warnings)\n    else:\n        data[\"reason\"] = \"All ejectability rules passed.\"\n    return data\n\n\ndef build_end_block(params: Mapping[str, Any] | Any | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Delegate to ``autoeject.build_end_block``.\"\"\"\n    return autoeject.build_end_block(params)\n\n\ndef inject_end_block(gcode: str | bytes | bytearray, params: Any) -> str | bytes:\n    \"\"\"Delegate to ``autoeject.inject_end_block``.\"\"\"\n    return autoeject.inject_end_block(gcode, params)\n\n\ndef loop_3mf(gcode_3mf_bytes: bytes, n: int) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Delegate to ``autoeject.loop_3mf``.\"\"\"\n    return autoeject.loop_3mf(gcode_3mf_bytes, n)\n\n\ndef run_on_sliced_file(\n    gcode_3mf_bytes: bytes,\n    n: int = 1,\n    params: Mapping[str, Any] | Any | None = None,\n) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Return modified ``.gcode.3mf`` bytes with the eject block and N copies.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(gcode_3mf_bytes, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        raise ValueError(\"gcode_3mf_bytes must be bytes\")\n    injected = autoeject.inject_end_block(bytes(gcode_3mf_bytes), params)\n    return autoeject.loop_3mf(injected, n)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Open questions from the v2 spec: explicit stubs rather than invented APIs\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef check_from_context(ctx: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Stub for obtaining STL bytes from an OrcaSlicer context.\"\"\"\n    raise NotImplementedError(\n        \"open question: no documented OrcaSlicer plugin API provides STL bytes \"\n        \"for autoeject.check(stl_bytes)\"\n    )\n\n\ndef locate_existing_end_block(ctx: Any) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Stub for locating the printer's existing end G-code through Orca.\"\"\"\n    raise NotImplementedError(\n        \"open question: no documented OrcaSlicer plugin API exposes the \"\n        \"existing end G-code to replace\"\n    )\n\n\ndef repeat_print_job(ctx: Any, n: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Stub for re-queuing a finished print N times via Orca.\"\"\"\n    raise NotImplementedError(\n        \"open question: no documented OrcaSlicer plugin API re-queues or \"\n        \"repeats a print N times\"\n    )\n\n\ndef start_print(ctx: Any) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Stub for starting a Bambu Lab A1 print through the plugin.\"\"\"\n    raise NotImplementedError(\n        \"open question: no documented OrcaSlicer plugin API starts a Bambu Lab \"\n        \"A1 print and interacts with lifecycle events\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _loop_count_from_context(ctx: Any, default: int) -> int:\n    for name in (\"n\", \"loop_count\", \"copies\"):\n        value = getattr(ctx, name, None)\n        if value is not None:\n            return _validate_loop_count(value)\n    return default\n\n\nclass EjectPipelineCapability(SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase):\n    \"\"\"SlicingPipeline capability implementing the named psGCodePostProcess hook.\"\"\"\n\n    has_config_ui = True\n\n    def get_default_config(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return get_default_config()\n\n    def get_config_ui(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n        return get_config_ui()\n\n    def get_config(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return get_config()\n\n    def save_config(\n        self, config: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None\n    ) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return save_config(config)\n\n    def execute(self, ctx: Any, n: int | None = None) -> Any:\n        \"\"\"Append/inject the eject block at ``Step.psGCodePostProcess``.\n\n        ``ctx.gcode_path`` may point at a plain ``.gcode`` file or a\n        ``.gcode.3mf`` archive.  The optional ``n`` argument is an extension\n        used by tests/CLI callers; the normal Orca hook call is ``execute(ctx)``\n        and the copy count then comes from ``ctx.n``/``ctx.loop_count``.\n        \"\"\"\n        step = getattr(ctx, \"step\", None)\n        if step is not None and step != Step.psGCodePostProcess:\n            return None\n\n        path = Path(getattr(ctx, \"gcode_path\"))\n        config = get_config()\n        params = {key: config[key] for key in DEFAULT_CONFIG}\n        loop_count = _loop_count_from_context(ctx, int(config.get(_LOOP_KEY, 1)))\n        if n is not None:\n            loop_count = _validate_loop_count(n)\n\n        raw = path.read_bytes()\n        if raw[:2] == b\"PK\":\n            injected = autoeject.inject_end_block(raw, params)\n            path.write_bytes(autoeject.loop_3mf(injected, loop_count))\n        else:\n            path.write_text(\n                autoeject.inject_end_block(raw.decode(\"utf-8\"), params),\n                encoding=\"utf-8\",\n            )\n        return None\n\n\n#: Module-level capability instance used by the manifest/plugin loader.\nPLUGIN = EjectPipelineCapability()\nCAPABILITY = PLUGIN\nplugin = PLUGIN\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"CAPABILITY\",\n    \"CONFIG_PATH\",\n    \"DEFAULT_CONFIG\",\n    \"EDITABLE_CONFIG\",\n    \"EjectPipelineCapability\",\n    \"MACHINE_END_END\",\n    \"MACHINE_END_START\",\n    \"PLUGIN\",\n    \"POSTPROCESS_MARKER\",\n    \"autoeject\",\n    \"build_end_block\",\n    \"check\",\n    \"check_from_context\",\n    \"get_config\",\n    \"get_config_ui\",\n    \"get_default_config\",\n    \"has_config_ui\",\n    \"inject_end_block\",\n    \"locate_existing_end_block\",\n    \"loop_3mf\",\n    \"repeat_print_job\",\n    \"run_on_sliced_file\",\n    \"save_config\",\n    \"start_print\",\n]\n",
    "orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject/__init__.py": "\"\"\"Vendored pure-Python core for generating supervised A1 eject jobs.\n\nThe OrcaSlicer plugin ships this package inside ``orca_plugin/vendor`` so the\nfolder can be installed into OrcaSlicer as-is.  The public functions re-exported\nhere are the ones the plugin calls; the implementation lives in the sibling\nmodules and is not duplicated in the plugin.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom .ejectability import Report, Rule, check\nfrom .end_block import EjectBlockParams, build_end_block, evaluate_end_block\nfrom .loop import loop_3mf\nfrom .slicer import (\n    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END,\n    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START,\n    MACHINE_END_START,\n    inject_end_block,\n)\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\",\n    \"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\",\n    \"EjectBlockParams\",\n    \"MACHINE_END_START\",\n    \"Report\",\n    \"Rule\",\n    \"build_end_block\",\n    \"check\",\n    \"evaluate_end_block\",\n    \"inject_end_block\",\n    \"loop_3mf\",\n]\n",
    "orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject/ejectability.py": "\"\"\"Deterministic STL ejectability checks for the 256 x 256 mm A1 bed.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import asdict, dataclass\nfrom io import BytesIO\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport trimesh\nfrom shapely.geometry import Polygon\nfrom shapely.ops import unary_union\n\n# A1 build volume only; no printer parameter anywhere.\nBED_WIDTH_MM = 256.0\nBED_DEPTH_MM = 256.0\n\n# Binding v1 ejectability thresholds (named constants).\nMAX_LAYER_Z_MM = 32.0\nBACK_STRIP_MM = 20.0\nBED_EDGE_MARGIN_MM = 20.0\nMIN_BASE_CONTACT_AREA_MM2 = 100.0\nMAX_TIP_OVER_RATIO = 3.0\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Rule:\n    id: str\n    measured: float | bool\n    threshold: str\n    verdict: str\n    reason: str\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return asdict(self)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Report:\n    verdict: str\n    rules: tuple[Rule, ...]\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"verdict\": self.verdict,\n            \"rules\": [rule.to_dict() for rule in self.rules],\n        }\n\n\ndef _base_footprint(mesh: trimesh.Trimesh) -> Polygon | Any:\n    \"\"\"Return the union of triangles touching the lowest plane of the mesh.\"\"\"\n    z_min = float(mesh.bounds[0, 2])\n    triangles = mesh.triangles\n    on_base = np.all(np.isclose(triangles[:, :, 2], z_min, atol=1e-7), axis=1)\n    polygons = []\n    for triangle in triangles[on_base, :, :2]:\n        polygon = Polygon(triangle)\n        if not polygon.is_valid:\n            polygon = polygon.buffer(0)\n        if not polygon.is_empty:\n            polygons.append(polygon)\n    if not polygons:\n        # A degenerate contact still receives deterministic measurements.\n        minimum, maximum = mesh.bounds[:, :2]\n        return Polygon(\n            [\n                (minimum[0], minimum[1]),\n                (maximum[0], minimum[1]),\n                (maximum[0], maximum[1]),\n                (minimum[0], maximum[1]),\n            ]\n        )\n    return unary_union(polygons)\n\n\ndef _shortest_width(footprint: Any) -> float:\n    rectangle = footprint.minimum_rotated_rectangle\n    coordinates = list(rectangle.exterior.coords)\n    if len(coordinates) < 2:\n        return 0.0\n    lengths = [\n        float(np.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]))\n        for a, b in zip(coordinates, coordinates[1:])\n    ]\n    return min(lengths, default=0.0)\n\n\ndef check(stl_bytes: bytes) -> Report:\n    \"\"\"Measure an STL and apply the five binding-v1 ejectability rules.\n\n    STL coordinates use the A1 plate coordinate system: the printable footprint\n    is 0..256 mm on both X and Y, with the back strip at high Y.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(stl_bytes, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        raise ValueError(\"STL content must be bytes\")\n    try:\n        mesh = trimesh.load(\n            BytesIO(bytes(stl_bytes)), file_type=\"stl\", force=\"mesh\", process=False\n        )\n    except Exception as exc:\n        raise ValueError(\"Could not read STL geometry\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(mesh, trimesh.Trimesh) or mesh.is_empty:\n        raise ValueError(\"STL contains no geometry\")\n    if not np.all(np.isfinite(mesh.bounds)):\n        raise ValueError(\"STL contains non-finite geometry\")\n\n    minimum, maximum = mesh.bounds\n    height = float(maximum[2] - minimum[2])\n    footprint = _base_footprint(mesh)\n    x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max = (float(value) for value in footprint.bounds)\n    base_area = float(footprint.area)\n    shortest_width = _shortest_width(footprint)\n    tip_ratio = height / shortest_width if shortest_width > 0 else float(\"inf\")\n\n    back_intrusion = max(0.0, y_max - (BED_DEPTH_MM - BACK_STRIP_MM))\n    edge_clearance = min(x_min, y_min, BED_WIDTH_MM - x_max, BED_DEPTH_MM - y_max)\n\n    low_height = height < MAX_LAYER_Z_MM\n    back_fail = back_intrusion > 0.0\n    margin_fail = edge_clearance < BED_EDGE_MARGIN_MM\n    area_fail = base_area < MIN_BASE_CONTACT_AREA_MM2\n    tip_fail = tip_ratio > MAX_TIP_OVER_RATIO\n\n    rules = (\n        Rule(\n            id=\"max_layer_z\",\n            measured=height,\n            threshold=f\"{MAX_LAYER_Z_MM:g} mm\",\n            verdict=\"warn\" if low_height else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"Part height is below 32 mm; use the supervised nozzle-push branch, \"\n                \"including G1 Z1.\"\n                if low_height\n                else \"Part height reaches the gantry-push range.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n        Rule(\n            id=\"back_strip\",\n            measured=back_intrusion,\n            threshold=f\"{BACK_STRIP_MM:g} mm\",\n            verdict=\"fail\" if back_fail else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"Footprint intrudes into the 20 mm back strip.\"\n                if back_fail\n                else \"Footprint stays clear of the 20 mm back strip.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n        Rule(\n            id=\"bed_edge_margin\",\n            measured=edge_clearance,\n            threshold=f\"{BED_EDGE_MARGIN_MM:g} mm\",\n            verdict=\"fail\" if margin_fail else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"Footprint is within 20 mm of a bed edge.\"\n                if margin_fail\n                else \"Footprint keeps the 20 mm bed edge margin.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n        Rule(\n            id=\"base_contact_area\",\n            measured=base_area,\n            threshold=f\"{MIN_BASE_CONTACT_AREA_MM2:g} mm\\u00b2\",\n            verdict=\"fail\" if area_fail else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"Base contact area is below 100 mm\\u00b2.\"\n                if area_fail\n                else \"Base contact area meets the 100 mm\\u00b2 minimum.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n        Rule(\n            id=\"tip_over_ratio\",\n            measured=tip_ratio,\n            threshold=f\"{MAX_TIP_OVER_RATIO:g}\",\n            verdict=\"fail\" if tip_fail else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"Tip-over ratio (height / base) is above 3.\"\n                if tip_fail\n                else \"Tip-over ratio (height / base) is within 3.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n    )\n\n    if any(rule.verdict == \"fail\" for rule in rules):\n        verdict = \"fail\"\n    elif any(rule.verdict == \"warn\" for rule in rules):\n        verdict = \"warn\"\n    else:\n        verdict = \"pass\"\n    return Report(verdict=verdict, rules=rules)\n",
    "orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject/end_block.py": "\"\"\"Build and safely evaluate the Factorian Designs A1 end block.\n\nThis is the vendored v1 ``autoeject`` generator used by the OrcaSlicer plugin.\nIts public parameter names and defaults match the binding v1 eject-block\nparameters so the capability config can be passed straight through.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport math\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nMIN_BED_TEMP_C = 0\nMAX_BED_TEMP_C = 120\nMIN_HOLD_S = 0\nMAX_HOLD_S = 3600\nMIN_CYCLE_COUNT = 1\nMAX_CYCLE_COUNT = 100\nMIN_GANTRY_PUSH_Z_MM = 0.0\nMAX_GANTRY_PUSH_Z_MM = 256.0\nMIN_NOZZLE_PUSH_Z_MM = 0.0\nMAX_NOZZLE_PUSH_Z_MM = 50.0\nMIN_PUSH_FEED_MM_MIN = 1\nMAX_PUSH_FEED_MM_MIN = 18000\nMIN_MAX_LAYER_Z_THRESHOLD_MM = 0.0\nMAX_MAX_LAYER_Z_THRESHOLD_MM = 256.0\n\n_TEMPLATE_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \"profiles\" / \"a1_end.gcode\"\n_PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r\"\\{([^{}]+)\\}\")\n_ARITHMETIC = re.compile(r\"^(max_layer_z)(?:\\s*([+-])\\s*(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?))?$\")\n_CYCLE_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"; --- ADDED: Special Cooling/Heating Sequence ---.*?\"\n    r\";======= Cool Down Done, Start Push Off\",\n    re.DOTALL,\n)\n_PUSH_MOVE = re.compile(r\"(?m)^G1 Y-0\\.5 F300(\\s*;.*)$\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass EjectBlockParams:\n    bed_heat_temp: int = 60\n    bed_cool_temp: int = 25\n    bed_heat_hold: int = 60\n    bed_cool_hold: int = 120\n    cycle_count: int = 3\n    gantry_push_z: float = 50.0\n    nozzle_push_z: float = 1.0\n    push_feed: int = 6000\n    max_layer_z_threshold: float = 41.0\n\n\ndef _integer(name: str, value: Any, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> int:\n    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):\n        raise ValueError(f\"{name} must be an integer\")\n    if not minimum <= value <= maximum:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{name} must be between {minimum} and {maximum}\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _number(name: str, value: Any, minimum: float, maximum: float) -> float:\n    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):\n        raise ValueError(f\"{name} must be a number\")\n    value = float(value)\n    if not math.isfinite(value) or not minimum <= value <= maximum:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{name} must be between {minimum} and {maximum}\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _validated_params(\n    params: EjectBlockParams | Mapping[str, Any] | None,\n) -> EjectBlockParams:\n    if params is None:\n        result = EjectBlockParams()\n    elif isinstance(params, EjectBlockParams):\n        result = params\n    elif isinstance(params, Mapping):\n        known = {field.name for field in fields(EjectBlockParams)}\n        unknown = set(params) - known\n        if unknown:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Unknown end-block parameter: {sorted(unknown)[0]}\")\n        try:\n            result = EjectBlockParams(**params)\n        except TypeError as exc:\n            raise ValueError(str(exc)) from exc\n    else:\n        raise ValueError(\"params must be an EjectBlockParams or a mapping\")\n\n    _integer(\"bed_heat_temp\", result.bed_heat_temp, MIN_BED_TEMP_C, MAX_BED_TEMP_C)\n    _integer(\"bed_cool_temp\", result.bed_cool_temp, MIN_BED_TEMP_C, MAX_BED_TEMP_C)\n    _integer(\"bed_heat_hold\", result.bed_heat_hold, MIN_HOLD_S, MAX_HOLD_S)\n    _integer(\"bed_cool_hold\", result.bed_cool_hold, MIN_HOLD_S, MAX_HOLD_S)\n    _integer(\"cycle_count\", result.cycle_count, MIN_CYCLE_COUNT, MAX_CYCLE_COUNT)\n    _number(\n        \"gantry_push_z\",\n        result.gantry_push_z,\n        MIN_GANTRY_PUSH_Z_MM,\n        MAX_GANTRY_PUSH_Z_MM,\n    )\n    _number(\n        \"nozzle_push_z\",\n        result.nozzle_push_z,\n        MIN_NOZZLE_PUSH_Z_MM,\n        MAX_NOZZLE_PUSH_Z_MM,\n    )\n    _integer(\"push_feed\", result.push_feed, MIN_PUSH_FEED_MM_MIN, MAX_PUSH_FEED_MM_MIN)\n    _number(\n        \"max_layer_z_threshold\",\n        result.max_layer_z_threshold,\n        MIN_MAX_LAYER_Z_THRESHOLD_MM,\n        MAX_MAX_LAYER_Z_THRESHOLD_MM,\n    )\n    return result\n\n\ndef build_end_block(params: EjectBlockParams | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Substitute the editable eject parameters, keeping slicer placeholders.\"\"\"\n    settings = _validated_params(params)\n    template = _TEMPLATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    lines = [\"; --- ADDED: Special Cooling/Heating Sequence ---\"]\n    for _ in range(settings.cycle_count):\n        lines.extend(\n            [\n                f\"M140 S{settings.bed_heat_temp} ; set bed heat temperature\",\n                f\"M190 S{settings.bed_heat_temp} ; wait for bed heat temperature\",\n                f\"G4 S{settings.bed_heat_hold} ; hold at heat temperature\",\n                f\"M140 S{settings.bed_cool_temp} ; set bed cool temperature\",\n                f\"M190 S{settings.bed_cool_temp} ; wait for bed cool temperature\",\n                f\"G4 S{settings.bed_cool_hold} ; hold at cool temperature\",\n            ]\n        )\n    lines.extend(\n        [\n            \"; --- END Special Cooling/Heating Sequence ---\",\n            \"M140 S0 ; turn off bed\",\n            \"G4 S60 ; wait for bed to cool before push\",\n            \"\",\n            \";======= Cool Down Done, Start Push Off\",\n        ]\n    )\n    block, count = _CYCLE_PATTERN.subn(lambda _: \"\\n\".join(lines), template)\n    if count != 1:\n        raise ValueError(\"A1 end template does not contain exactly one heat/cool sequence\")\n    block, count = _PUSH_MOVE.subn(\n        lambda match: f\"G1 Y-0.5 F{settings.push_feed}{match.group(1)}\", block\n    )\n    if count != 1:\n        raise ValueError(\"A1 end template does not contain exactly one push move\")\n    return block\n\n\ndef _number_text(value: float) -> str:\n    return f\"{value:.12g}\"\n\n\ndef _expression(expression: str, values: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:\n    expression = expression.strip()\n    if expression == \"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower[1]\":\n        try:\n            value = values[\"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower\"][1]\n            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):\n                raise TypeError\n            if not math.isfinite(value):\n                raise ValueError\n            return _number_text(value)\n        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n            raise ValueError(\"Invalid first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower[1]\") from exc\n    match = _ARITHMETIC.fullmatch(expression)\n    if match:\n        try:\n            value = values[\"max_layer_z\"]\n            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):\n                raise TypeError\n            value = float(value)\n            if not math.isfinite(value):\n                raise ValueError\n        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n            raise ValueError(\"Invalid max_layer_z\") from exc\n        if match.group(2):\n            operand = float(match.group(3))\n            value = value + operand if match.group(2) == \"+\" else value - operand\n        return _number_text(value)\n    raise ValueError(f\"Unsupported BambuStudio placeholder: {{{expression}}}\")\n\n\ndef _condition(condition: str, values: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:\n    compact = re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \"\", condition)\n    if compact == '!spiral_mode&&print_sequence!=\"byobject\"':\n        try:\n            spiral_mode = values[\"spiral_mode\"]\n            print_sequence = values[\"print_sequence\"]\n        except KeyError as exc:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Missing end-block value: {exc.args[0]}\") from exc\n        if not isinstance(spiral_mode, bool) or not isinstance(print_sequence, str):\n            raise ValueError(\"Invalid spiral_mode or print_sequence\")\n        return not spiral_mode and print_sequence != \"by object\"\n    if compact in {\"(max_layer_z)>41\", \"(max_layer_z+100.0)<256\"}:\n        try:\n            value = values[\"max_layer_z\"]\n            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):\n                raise TypeError\n            if not math.isfinite(value):\n                raise ValueError\n            return value > 41 if compact == \"(max_layer_z)>41\" else value + 100.0 < 256\n        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n            raise ValueError(\"Invalid max_layer_z\") from exc\n    raise ValueError(f\"Unsupported BambuStudio conditional: {{if {condition}}}\")\n\n\ndef evaluate_end_block(block: str, values: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Evaluate only the placeholders and conditionals the A1 template uses.\n\n    Unknown placeholders and malformed conditional nesting raise ValueError so\n    no unevaluated BambuStudio text can ever reach printer G-code.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(block, str) or not isinstance(values, Mapping):\n        raise ValueError(\"block must be text and values must be a mapping\")\n\n    # Validate every placeholder, including ones in branches we will not emit.\n    for match in _PLACEHOLDER.finditer(block):\n        expression = match.group(1).strip()\n        if expression.startswith(\"if \") or expression in {\"else\", \"endif\"}:\n            if expression.startswith(\"if \"):\n                _condition(expression[3:], values)\n        else:\n            _expression(expression, values)\n\n    output: list[str] = []\n    conditions: list[tuple[bool, bool, bool]] = []\n    active = True\n    for line in block.splitlines(keepends=True):\n        stripped = line.strip()\n        directive = stripped[1:].strip() if stripped.startswith(\";{\") else stripped\n        if directive.startswith(\"{if \") and directive.endswith(\"}\"):\n            condition = _condition(directive[4:-1], values)\n            conditions.append((active, condition, False))\n            active = active and condition\n        elif directive == \"{else}\":\n            if not conditions or conditions[-1][2]:\n                raise ValueError(\"Unexpected or duplicate {else}\")\n            parent, condition, _ = conditions.pop()\n            conditions.append((parent, condition, True))\n            active = parent and not condition\n        elif directive == \"{endif}\":\n            if not conditions:\n                raise ValueError(\"Unexpected {endif}\")\n            parent, _, _ = conditions.pop()\n            active = parent\n        elif active:\n            output.append(_PLACEHOLDER.sub(lambda m: _expression(m.group(1), values), line))\n    if conditions:\n        raise ValueError(\"Unclosed {if} block\")\n    result = \"\".join(output)\n    leftover = _PLACEHOLDER.search(result)\n    if leftover:\n        raise ValueError(f\"Unevaluated placeholder: {leftover.group(0)}\")\n    return result\n",
    "orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject/loop.py": "\"\"\"Repeat an already sliced A1 executable block to print N copies in one job.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom .slicer import (\n    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END,\n    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START,\n    PLATE_GCODE_NAME,\n    PLATE_MD5_NAME,\n    assert_no_placeholders,\n    find_unique_line,\n    md5_hex,\n    read_archive,\n    rewrite_archive,\n)\n\nMIN_COPIES = 1\nMAX_COPIES = 100\n\n\ndef _copies(n: int) -> int:\n    if isinstance(n, bool) or not isinstance(n, int):\n        raise ValueError(\"n must be an integer\")\n    if not MIN_COPIES <= n <= MAX_COPIES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"n must be between {MIN_COPIES} and {MAX_COPIES}\")\n    return n\n\n\ndef loop_3mf(gcode_3mf_bytes: bytes, n: int) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Repeat the ``; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START``..``; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`` body.\n\n    The body already contains the machine start, the print, the cooldown/eject\n    sequence and the machine end, so repeating it restores the starting\n    temperatures and initial conditions before every copy.  The plate MD5\n    companion is rewritten and raw placeholders on executable lines are\n    rejected.\n    \"\"\"\n    count = _copies(n)\n\n    entries = read_archive(gcode_3mf_bytes)\n    if PLATE_GCODE_NAME not in entries:\n        raise ValueError(f\"archive has no {PLATE_GCODE_NAME}\")\n    text = entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)\n    start = find_unique_line(lines, EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START)\n    end = find_unique_line(lines, EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END)\n    if end <= start:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END!r} must follow {EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START!r}\")\n    body = lines[start + 1 : end]\n    if not body:\n        raise ValueError(\"executable block is empty\")\n\n    updated = \"\".join(lines[: start + 1] + body * count + lines[end:])\n    assert_no_placeholders(updated)\n\n    gcode_bytes = updated.encode(\"utf-8\")\n    return rewrite_archive(\n        gcode_3mf_bytes,\n        {\n            PLATE_GCODE_NAME: gcode_bytes,\n            PLATE_MD5_NAME: md5_hex(gcode_bytes).encode(\"ascii\"),\n        },\n    )\n",
    "orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject/sim.py": "\"\"\"Minimal axis-aligned-box simulation of the evaluated A1 eject end block.\n\nThe simulator replays only the ``G0``/``G1``/``G90``/``G91`` moves of an\nalready evaluated eject block against four axis-aligned boxes:\n\n* the toolhead/nozzle box, following the programmed nozzle position,\n* the gantry bar, spanning X at the nozzle height,\n* the bed, which moves in Y and carries the part,\n* the part, positioned by the caller's bounding box.\n\nThe box dimensions below are deliberately approximate and are **not measured**\nfrom a real A1.  They exist to give deterministic, reproducible findings and a\nshort animation for the UI, not to make a physical safety claim.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport math\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Any, Iterable, Sequence\n\nfrom .slicer import EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, MACHINE_END_START\n\n# --- approximate box dimensions, not measured ------------------------------\nTOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM = 40.0  # approximate, not measured\nTOOLHEAD_HEIGHT_MM = 40.0  # approximate, not measured\nGANTRY_BAR_Y_THICKNESS_MM = 10.0  # approximate, not measured\nGANTRY_BAR_Z_CLEARANCE_MM = 8.0  # approximate, not measured\nGANTRY_BAR_HEIGHT_MM = 60.0  # approximate, not measured\nBED_WIDTH_MM = 256.0  # approximate, not measured\nBED_DEPTH_MM = 256.0  # approximate, not measured\nBED_THICKNESS_MM = 5.0  # approximate, not measured\nOVERLAP_EPS_MM = 1e-6\n\n_NUMBER = r\"-?(?:\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?|\\.\\d+)\"\n_COMMAND = re.compile(rf\"^([A-Za-z])\\s*({_NUMBER})?\")\n_WORD = re.compile(rf\"([A-Za-z])\\s*({_NUMBER})\")\n_LAYER_MARKER = re.compile(r\"^;\\s*(?:CHANGE_LAYER|LAYER_CHANGE)\\s*$\")\n_MAX_Z_HEIGHT = re.compile(r\"^;\\s*max_z_height:\\s*(-?[0-9.]+)\\s*$\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Box:\n    \"\"\"Axis-aligned bounding box in plate coordinates (millimetres).\"\"\"\n\n    xmin: float\n    ymin: float\n    zmin: float\n    xmax: float\n    ymax: float\n    zmax: float\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_bounds(cls, bounds: Sequence[float]) -> \"Box\":\n        if len(bounds) != 6:\n            raise ValueError(\"part_bbox must have six values\")\n        values = [float(value) for value in bounds]\n        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in values):\n            raise ValueError(\"part_bbox must be finite\")\n        xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax = values\n        if xmin > xmax or ymin > ymax or zmin > zmax:\n            raise ValueError(\"part_bbox min values must not exceed max values\")\n        return cls(xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax)\n\n    @property\n    def center_x(self) -> float:\n        return (self.xmin + self.xmax) / 2.0\n\n    @property\n    def center_y(self) -> float:\n        return (self.ymin + self.ymax) / 2.0\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Move:\n    \"\"\"One replayed spatial G0/G1 move.\"\"\"\n\n    i: int\n    x: float\n    y: float\n    z: float\n    feedrate: float | None = None\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, float | int]:\n        return {\"i\": self.i, \"x\": self.x, \"y\": self.y, \"z\": self.z}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Collision:\n    \"\"\"A toolhead or gantry box that hit the part outside a Y push move.\"\"\"\n\n    move_index: int\n    box: str\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"move_index\": self.move_index, \"box\": self.box}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass SimReport:\n    \"\"\"Deterministic simulation result for the UI and the API.\"\"\"\n\n    pushed: bool\n    pushed_by: tuple[str, ...]\n    collisions: tuple[Collision, ...]\n    moves: tuple[Move, ...]\n    unknown_commands: int\n\n    @property\n    def missed_push(self) -> bool:\n        return not self.pushed\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"pushed\": self.pushed,\n            \"pushed_by\": list(self.pushed_by),\n            \"missed_push\": self.missed_push,\n            \"collisions\": [collision.to_dict() for collision in self.collisions],\n            \"moves\": [move.to_dict() for move in self.moves],\n            \"unknown_commands\": self.unknown_commands,\n        }\n\n\ndef _overlaps(a_min: float, a_max: float, b_min: float, b_max: float) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Strict overlap so merely touching a face is not a collision.\"\"\"\n    return a_min < b_max - OVERLAP_EPS_MM and a_max > b_min + OVERLAP_EPS_MM\n\n\ndef _hits(box: Box, part: Box) -> bool:\n    return (\n        _overlaps(box.xmin, box.xmax, part.xmin, part.xmax)\n        and _overlaps(box.ymin, box.ymax, part.ymin, part.ymax)\n        and _overlaps(box.zmin, box.zmax, part.zmin, part.zmax)\n    )\n\n\ndef _swept(previous: tuple[float, float, float], current: tuple[float, float, float]):\n    \"\"\"Return the toolhead and gantry boxes swept by one move.\"\"\"\n    px, py, pz = previous\n    cx, cy, cz = current\n    toolhead = Box(\n        min(px, cx) - TOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM / 2.0,\n        min(py, cy) - TOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM / 2.0,\n        min(pz, cz),\n        max(px, cx) + TOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM / 2.0,\n        max(py, cy) + TOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM / 2.0,\n        max(pz, cz) + TOOLHEAD_HEIGHT_MM,\n    )\n    gantry = Box(\n        0.0,\n        min(py, cy) - GANTRY_BAR_Y_THICKNESS_MM / 2.0,\n        min(pz, cz) + GANTRY_BAR_Z_CLEARANCE_MM,\n        BED_WIDTH_MM,\n        max(py, cy) + GANTRY_BAR_Y_THICKNESS_MM / 2.0,\n        max(pz, cz) + GANTRY_BAR_Z_CLEARANCE_MM + GANTRY_BAR_HEIGHT_MM,\n    )\n    return toolhead, gantry\n\n\ndef _strip_comment(line: str) -> str:\n    return line.split(\";\", 1)[0].strip()\n\n\ndef _words(rest: str) -> dict[str, float]:\n    return {letter.upper(): float(value) for letter, value in _WORD.findall(rest)}\n\n\ndef simulate(eject_gcode_evaluated: str, part_bbox: Any) -> SimReport:\n    \"\"\"Replay an evaluated eject block and report push/collision findings.\n\n    ``part_bbox`` is the part's real axis-aligned box in plate coordinates as\n    ``(xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax)`` (a ``(2, 3)`` trimesh-style bounds\n    array is also accepted).  Only ``G0``/``G1``/``G90``/``G91`` are understood;\n    every other command is ignored and counted in ``unknown_commands``.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(eject_gcode_evaluated, str):\n        raise ValueError(\"eject_gcode_evaluated must be text\")\n\n    bounds = getattr(part_bbox, \"bounds\", None)\n    if bounds is not None and bounds is not part_bbox:\n        part = Box.from_bounds(list(bounds.reshape(-1)))\n    else:\n        part = Box.from_bounds(part_bbox)\n\n    # The block starts where printing stopped: over the part, at its top surface.\n    x, y, z = part.center_x, part.center_y, part.zmax\n    absolute = True\n    feedrate: float | None = None\n\n    moves: list[Move] = []\n    collisions: list[Collision] = []\n    pushed_by: set[str] = set()\n    ejected = False\n    unknown = 0\n\n    for raw_line in eject_gcode_evaluated.splitlines():\n        line = _strip_comment(raw_line)\n        if not line:\n            continue\n        match = _COMMAND.match(line)\n        if not match:\n            unknown += 1\n            continue\n        letter = match.group(1).upper()\n        number = match.group(2)\n\n        if letter == \"G\" and
