if absolute:\n                next_x = params.get(\"X\", x)\n                next_y = params.get(\"Y\", y)\n                next_z = params.get(\"Z\", z)\n            else:\n                next_x = x + params[\"X\"] if \"X\" in params else x\n                next_y = y + params[\"Y\"] if \"Y\" in params else y\n                next_z = z + params[\"Z\"] if \"Z\" in params else z\n            if (next_x, next_y, next_z) == previous:\n                continue\n\n            toolhead, gantry = _swept(previous, (next_x, next_y, next_z))\n            contact = [\n                name\n                for name, box in ((\"nozzle\", toolhead), (\"gantry\", gantry))\n                if _hits(box, part)\n            ]\n            if contact and not ejected:\n                has_y_motion = abs(next_y - y) > OVERLAP_EPS_MM\n                if has_y_motion:\n                    # The Y push is the intended ejection move.\n                    pushed_by.update(contact)\n                    ejected = True\n                else:\n                    # Any other box contact is an unintended collision.\n                    move_index = len(moves)\n                    collisions.extend(\n                        Collision(move_index=move_index, box=name)\n                        for name in contact\n                    )\n\n            x, y, z = next_x, next_y, next_z\n            moves.append(Move(len(moves), x, y, z, feedrate))\n        elif letter == \"G\" and number == \"90\":\n            absolute = True\n        elif letter == \"G\" and number == \"91\":\n            absolute = False\n        else:\n            unknown += 1\n\n    return SimReport(\n        pushed=bool(pushed_by),\n        pushed_by=tuple(sorted(pushed_by)),\n        collisions=tuple(collisions),\n        moves=tuple(moves),\n        unknown_commands=unknown,\n    )\n\n\ndef extract_end_block(gcode_text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the text from ``; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START`` through the block end.\n\n    The eject simulation and preview only care about the end block, so callers\n    pass this slice rather than a whole printed plate.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(gcode_text, str):\n        raise ValueError(\"gcode_text must be text\")\n    start = gcode_text.find(MACHINE_END_START)\n    if start < 0 or gcode_text.find(MACHINE_END_START, start + 1) >= 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected exactly one {MACHINE_END_START!r} marker\")\n    end = gcode_text.find(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, start)\n    if end < 0 or gcode_text.find(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, end + 1) >= 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected exactly one {EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END!r} marker\")\n    return gcode_text[start : end + len(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END)]\n\n\ndef part_bbox_from_gcode(gcode_text: str) -> tuple[float, float, float, float, float, float]:\n    \"\"\"Derive a part box from header ``max_z_height`` and the first layer.\n\n    The XY extent comes from the first layer's extrusion moves, which is the\n    base footprint that actually sits on the plate.  This is the pre-sliced\n    counterpart of measuring an STL's bounds.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(gcode_text, str):\n        raise ValueError(\"gcode_text must be text\")\n    lines = gcode_text.splitlines()\n\n    max_z: float | None = None\n    for line in lines:\n        match = _MAX_Z_HEIGHT.match(line.strip())\n        if match:\n            max_z = float(match.group(1))\n            break\n    if max_z is None or not math.isfinite(max_z):\n        raise ValueError(\"gcode has no finite max_z_height header\")\n\n    markers = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if _LAYER_MARKER.match(line.strip())]\n    if not markers:\n        start, stop = 0, len(lines)\n    else:\n        start = markers[0] + 1\n        stop = markers[1] if len(markers) > 1 else len(lines)\n\n    extrusion_x: list[float] = []\n    extrusion_y: list[float] = []\n    loose_x: list[float] = []\n    loose_y: list[float] = []\n    for raw_line in lines[start:stop]:\n        line = _strip_comment(raw_line)\n        if not line:\n            continue\n        match = _COMMAND.match(line)\n        if not match or match.group(1).upper() != \"G\" or match.group(2) not in {\"0\", \"1\"}:\n            continue\n        params = _words(line[match.end(1) :])\n        if \"X\" not in params or \"Y\" not in params:\n            continue\n        loose_x.append(params[\"X\"])\n        loose_y.append(params[\"Y\"])\n        if params.get(\"E\", 0.0) > 0.0:\n            extrusion_x.append(params[\"X\"])\n            extrusion_y.append(params[\"Y\"])\n\n    xs = extrusion_x or loose_x\n    ys = extrusion_y or loose_y\n    if not xs or not ys:\n        raise ValueError(\"first layer has no XY moves to measure\")\n    return (min(xs), min(ys), 0.0, max(xs), max(ys), max_z)\n",
    "orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject/slicer.py": "\"\"\"Headless A1 slicing and safe end-block injection for ``.gcode.3mf`` files.\n\nTwo independent entry points live here:\n\n* :func:`slice_stl` drives the BambuStudio CLI with the CLI's own installed\n  system profiles, patching only ``machine_end_gcode`` in a copy of the A1\n  machine profile.\n* :func:`inject_end_block` rewrites the evaluated stock end block of an\n  already sliced A1 ``.gcode.3mf``.\n\nBoth keep the archive valid by recomputing ``Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5``.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport tempfile\nimport zipfile\nfrom io import BytesIO\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom .end_block import evaluate_end_block\n\nPLATE_GCODE_NAME = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\"\nPLATE_MD5_NAME = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5\"\nPLATE_JSON_NAME = \"Metadata/plate_1.json\"\n\nMACHINE_END_START = \"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\"\nEXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START = \"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\"\nEXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END = \"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\"\n\nA1_MACHINE_PROFILE = \"Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle\"\n\n_PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r\"\\{[^{}]*\\}\")\n_SAFE_POS = re.compile(r\"^G1\\s+X(-?[\\d.]+)\\s+Y(-?[\\d.]+)\\s+F18000\\b\")\n\n\nclass SliceError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when headless slicing cannot produce a plate archive.\"\"\"\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Archive helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef read_archive(archive_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, bytes]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``name -> bytes`` for every member of a ZIP-based 3MF.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(archive_bytes, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        raise ValueError(\"archive content must be bytes\")\n    try:\n        with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(bytes(archive_bytes))) as archive:\n            if archive.testzip() is not None:\n                raise ValueError(\"archive is corrupt\")\n            return {info.filename: archive.read(info) for info in archive.infolist()}\n    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:\n        raise ValueError(\"not a ZIP-based .gcode.3mf archive\") from exc\n\n\ndef rewrite_archive(archive_bytes: bytes, replacements: dict[str, bytes]) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Rebuild an archive replacing member payloads while keeping metadata.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(archive_bytes, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        raise ValueError(\"archive content must be bytes\")\n    source = zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(bytes(archive_bytes)))\n    if source.testzip() is not None:\n        raise ValueError(\"archive is corrupt\")\n    output = BytesIO()\n    with source, zipfile.ZipFile(output, \"w\") as destination:\n        for info in source.infolist():\n            data = replacements.get(info.filename)\n            if data is None:\n                data = source.read(info.filename)\n            destination.writestr(info, data)\n    return output.getvalue()\n\n\ndef md5_hex(data: bytes) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Uppercase hex MD5, matching BambuStudio's ``.gcode.md5`` companion.\"\"\"\n    return hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest().upper()\n\n\ndef read_plate_gcode(archive_bytes: bytes) -> str:\n    entries = read_archive(archive_bytes)\n    if PLATE_GCODE_NAME not in entries:\n        raise ValueError(f\"archive has no {PLATE_GCODE_NAME}\")\n    return entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef assert_no_placeholders(gcode_text: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reject raw BambuStudio placeholders on executable (non-comment) lines.\"\"\"\n    for number, line in enumerate(gcode_text.splitlines(), start=1):\n        if line.lstrip().startswith(\";\"):\n            continue\n        match = _PLACEHOLDER.search(line)\n        if match:\n            raise ValueError(\n                f\"unevaluated placeholder {match.group(0)} on line {number}\"\n            )\n\n\ndef find_unique_line(lines: list[str], marker: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the index of the single line equal to ``marker`` else raise.\"\"\"\n    indexes = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\") == marker]\n    if len(indexes) != 1:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected exactly one {marker!r} marker, found {len(indexes)}\")\n    return indexes[0]\n\n\ndef replace_between_lines(\n    text: str, start_marker: str, end_marker: str, replacement: str\n) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Replace the content between two unique marker lines, keeping the markers.\"\"\"\n    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)\n    start = find_unique_line(lines, start_marker)\n    end = find_unique_line(lines, end_marker)\n    if end <= start:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{end_marker!r} must follow {start_marker!r}\")\n    block = replacement if replacement.endswith(\"\\n\") else replacement + \"\\n\"\n    return \"\".join(lines[: start + 1]) + block + \"\".join(lines[end:])\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Header / config parsing\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _parse_header(gcode_text: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    header: dict[str, str] = {}\n    for line in gcode_text.splitlines():\n        stripped = line.strip()\n        if stripped == \"; HEADER_BLOCK_END\":\n            break\n        if not stripped.startswith(\";\"):\n            continue\n        key, separator, value = stripped[1:].partition(\":\")\n        key = key.strip()\n        if separator and re.fullmatch(r\"[A-Za-z0-9_]+\", key):\n            header[key] = value.strip()\n    return header\n\n\ndef _parse_config(gcode_text: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    config: dict[str, str] = {}\n    inside = False\n    for line in gcode_text.splitlines():\n        stripped = line.strip()\n        if stripped == \"; CONFIG_BLOCK_START\":\n            inside = True\n            continue\n        if stripped == \"; CONFIG_BLOCK_END\":\n            break\n        if not inside or not stripped.startswith(\";\") or \"=\" not in stripped:\n            continue\n        key, _, value = stripped[1:].partition(\"=\")\n        config[key.strip()] = value.strip()\n    return config\n\n\ndef _float_list(value: str) -> list[float]:\n    numbers = []\n    for item in value.replace(\",\", \" \").split():\n        numbers.append(float(item))\n    return numbers\n\n\ndef _first_layer_center(\n    gcode_text: str, entries: dict[str, bytes], config: dict[str, str]\n) -> list[float]:\n    if \"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower\" in config:\n        numbers = _float_list(config[\"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower\"])\n        if len(numbers) >= 2:\n            return numbers[:2]\n\n    minimum = config.get(\"first_layer_print_min\")\n    size = config.get(\"first_layer_print_size\")\n    if minimum and size:\n        lower = _float_list(minimum)\n        extent = _float_list(size)\n        if len(lower) >= 2 and len(extent) >= 2:\n            return [lower[0] + extent[0] / 2.0, lower[1] + extent[1] / 2.0]\n\n    plate_json = entries.get(PLATE_JSON_NAME)\n    if plate_json:\n        try:\n            bbox = json.loads(plate_json.decode(\"utf-8\")).get(\"bbox_all\")\n        except (ValueError, TypeError):\n            bbox = None\n        if isinstance(bbox, list) and len(bbox) == 4:\n            return [(bbox[0] + bbox[2]) / 2.0, (bbox[1] + bbox[3]) / 2.0]\n\n    for line in gcode_text.splitlines():\n        match = _SAFE_POS.match(line.strip())\n        if match:\n            return [float(match.group(1)), float(match.group(2))]\n\n    raise ValueError(\"cannot determine first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower\")\n\n\ndef frame_values(gcode_text: str, entries: dict[str, bytes]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Collect the BambuStudio values the A1 end block needs to evaluate.\"\"\"\n    header = _parse_header(gcode_text)\n    config = _parse_config(gcode_text)\n\n    if \"max_z_height\" not in header:\n        raise ValueError(\"header does not define max_z_height\")\n    max_layer_z = float(header[\"max_z_height\"])\n\n    spiral_raw = config.get(\"spiral_mode\", \"0\").strip()\n    spiral_mode = spiral_raw not in {\"0\", \"\", \"false\", \"False\"}\n\n    print_sequence = config.get(\"print_sequence\", \"by layer\").strip()\n\n    return {\n        \"max_layer_z\": max_layer_z,\n        \"spiral_mode\": spiral_mode,\n        \"print_sequence\": print_sequence,\n        \"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower\": _first_layer_center(\n            gcode_text, entries, config\n        ),\n    }\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Pre-sliced fallback\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef inject_end_block(gcode_3mf_bytes: bytes, end_block_template: str) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Replace the evaluated stock end block of a sliced A1 archive.\n\n    The span ``; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START`` .. ``; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`` is\n    replaced with ``end_block_template`` evaluated against the file's own\n    header and config values.  The plate MD5 companion is rewritten.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(end_block_template, str) or not end_block_template.strip():\n        raise ValueError(\"end_block_template must be non-empty text\")\n\n    entries = read_archive(gcode_3mf_bytes)\n    if PLATE_GCODE_NAME not in entries:\n        raise ValueError(f\"archive has no {PLATE_GCODE_NAME}\")\n    text = entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n    values = frame_values(text, entries)\n    evaluated = evaluate_end_block(end_block_template, values)\n\n    updated = replace_between_lines(\n        text, MACHINE_END_START, EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, evaluated\n    )\n    assert_no_placeholders(updated)\n\n    gcode_bytes = updated.encode(\"utf-8\")\n    return rewrite_archive(\n        gcode_3mf_bytes,\n        {\n            PLATE_GCODE_NAME: gcode_bytes,\n            PLATE_MD5_NAME: md5_hex(gcode_bytes).encode(\"ascii\"),\n        },\n    )\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Headless slicing\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _profile_roots(cli_path: Path) -> list[Path]:\n    roots: list[Path] = []\n    override = os.environ.get(\"BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT\")\n    if override:\n        roots.append(Path(override))\n    for base in (cli_path.parent, cli_path.parent.parent):\n        roots.append(base / \"resources\" / \"profiles\" / \"BBL\")\n        roots.append(base / \"resources\" / \"profiles\")\n        roots.append(base / \"profiles\")\n    roots.extend(\n        [\n            Path(\"/opt/bambustudio/resources/profiles/BBL\"),\n            Path(\"/usr/share/BambuStudio/resources/profiles/BBL\"),\n            Path.home() / \".config\" / \"BambuStudio\" / \"system\" / \"BBL\",\n            Path.home() / \"Library/Application Support/BambuStudio/system/BBL\",\n        ]\n    )\n    seen: set[Path] = set()\n cli_path: Path, kind: str | None = None) -> Path:\n    for root in _profile_roots(cli_path):\n        if not root.is_dir():\n            continue\n        candidates = [root / f\"{name}.json\"]\n        if kind:\n            candidates.insert(0, root / kind / f\"{name}.json\")\n        for candidate in candidates:\n            if candidate.is_file():\n                return candidate\n        for candidate in root.rglob(f\"{name}.json\"):\n            if candidate.is_file():\n                return candidate\n    suffix = f\" ({kind})\" if kind else \"\"\n    raise SliceError(f\"installed BambuStudio profile {name!r}{suffix} not found\")\n\n\ndef _resolve_profile(value: str, cli_path: Path, kind: str) -> Path:\n    direct = Path(value)\n    if direct.is_file():\n        return direct\n    return _find_profile(value, cli_path, kind)\n\n\ndef slice_stl(stl_bytes: bytes, end_block: str) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Slice ``stl_bytes`` with the stock A1 profile and return a ``.gcode.3mf``.\n\n    The CLI path comes from ``BAMBU_CLI``.  ``end_block`` (which may still hold\n    BambuStudio placeholders) is written into a copy of the CLI's own installed\n    ``Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle`` machine profile under ``machine_end_gcode``;\n    the profile is passed to the CLI rather than the block appearing as a shell\n    argument, so BambuStudio evaluates the placeholders itself.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(stl_bytes, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        raise SliceError(\"STL content must be bytes\")\n    if not isinstance(end_block, str) or not end_block.strip():\n        raise SliceError(\"end block must be non-empty text\")\n\n    cli_env = os.environ.get(\"BAMBU_CLI\")\n    if not cli_env:\n        raise SliceError(\n            \"BAMBU_CLI is not set; upload a pre-sliced .gcode.3mf instead\"\n        )\n    cli_path = Path(cli_env)\n    if not cli_path.is_file():\n        raise SliceError(\n            f\"BAMBU_CLI {cli_env!r} does not exist; use the pre-sliced fallback\"\n        )\n\n    machine_name = os.environ.get(\"BAMBU_MACHINE_PROFILE\", A1_MACHINE_PROFILE)\n    machine_path = _find_profile(machine_name, cli_path, \"machine\")\n    try:\n        machine = json.loads(machine_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:\n        raise SliceError(f\"could not read machine profile {machine_path}\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(machine, dict):\n        raise SliceError(f\"machine profile {machine_path} is not a JSON object\")\n\n    process_name = os.environ.get(\"BAMBU_PROCESS_PROFILE\") or machine.get(\n        \"default_print_profile\"\n    )\n    filament_name = os.environ.get(\"BAMBU_FILAMENT_PROFILE\")\n    if not filament_name:\n        default_filament = machine.get(\"default_filament_profile\")\n        if isinstance(default_filament, list) and default_filament:\n            filament_name = default_filament[0]\n        elif isinstance(default_filament, str):\n            filament_name = default_filament\n    if not process_name or not filament_name:\n        raise SliceError(\n            \"machine profile does not name default process/filament profiles; \"\n            \"set BAMBU_PROCESS_PROFILE and BAMBU_FILAMENT_PROFILE\"\n        )\n    process_path = _resolve_profile(str(process_name), cli_path, \"process\")\n    filament_path = _resolve_profile(str(filament_name), cli_path, \"filament\")\n\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\"autoeject-slice-\") as workspace:\n        directory = Path(workspace)\n        stl_path = directory / \"model.stl\"\n        stl_path.write_bytes(bytes(stl_bytes))\n        patched_path = directory / \"machine.json\"\n        machine[\"machine_end_gcode\"] = end_block\n        patched_path.write_text(json.dumps(machine, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        output_path = directory / \"result.gcode.3mf\"\n\n        command = [\n            str(cli_path),\n            \"--load-settings\",\n            f\"{patched_path};{process_path}\",\n            \"--load-filaments\",\n            str(filament_path),\n            \"--export-3mf\",\n            str(output_path),\n            str(stl_path),\n        ]\n        try:\n            completed = subprocess.run(\n                command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False\n            )\n exc\n\n        if completed.returncode != 0 or not output_path.is_file():\n            detail = (completed.stderr or completed.stdout or \"\").strip()\n            raise SliceError(\n     "tests/test_orca_plugin.py": "\"\"\"Tests for the OrcaSlicer 2.5 SlicingPipeline plugin.\n\nA fake ``orca`` module supplies exactly the names the v2 spec lists\n(``orca.slicing.SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase`` and ``orca.slicing.Step``).\nThe tests exercise the real plugin and the real vendored ``autoeject`` code;\nnothing is mocked across the plugin/autoeject boundary except in the explicit\nmonkeypatch test, which asserts the boundary is actually used.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport sys\nimport types\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nimport trimesh\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Fake orca module (matching the spec's hook signatures)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\norca = types.ModuleType(\"orca\")\nslicing = types.ModuleType(\"orca.slicing\")\n\n\nclass SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase:\n    \"\"\"Fake base class for the SlicingPipeline capability type.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass Step:\n    psGCodePreProcess = \"psGCodePreProcess\"\n    psGCodePostProcess = \"psGCodePostProcess\"\n\n\nslicing.SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase = SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase\nslicing.Step = Step\norca.slicing = slicing\nsys.modules[\"orca\"] = orca\nsys.modules[\"orca.slicing\"] = slicing\n\nimport orca_plugin.autoeject_a1 as plugin  # noqa: E402\nfrom orca_plugin.vendor.autoeject.slicer import (  # noqa: E402\n    PLATE_GCODE_NAME,\n    PLATE_MD5_NAME,\n    read_archive,\n)\n\nFIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \"fixtures\" / \"real_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n\nPLAIN_GCODE = (\n    \"; HEADER_BLOCK_START\\n\"\n    \"; max_z_height: 20.08\\n\"\n    \"; HEADER_BLOCK_END\\n\"\n    \"G1 X128 Y128 F6000\\n\"\n)\n\n\nclass Ctx:\n    \"\"\"Minimal fake slicing context carrying only ``gcode_path`` and ``step``.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, gcode_path: Path, step: str, n: int | None = None) -> None:\n        self.gcode_path = str(gcode_path)\n        self.step = step\n        if n is not None:\n            self.n = n\n\n\ndef _stl(mesh: trimesh.Trimesh) -> bytes:\n    return mesh.export(file_type=\"stl\")\n\n\ndef _centered_cube(size: float) -> trimesh.Trimesh:\n    mesh = trimesh.creation.box(extents=(size, size, size))\n    mesh.apply_translation((128, 128, size / 2))\n    return mesh\n\n\ndef _isolate_config(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path) -> Path:\n    config = tmp_path / \"orca_plugin.json\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(plugin, \"CONFIG_PATH\", config)\n    return config\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Registration / packaging\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_plugin_registers_a_slicing_pipeline_capability():\n    assert issubclass(plugin.EjectPipelineCapability, SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase)\n    assert isinstance(plugin.PLUGIN, plugin.EjectPipelineCapability)\n    assert plugin.plugin is plugin.PLUGIN\n    assert plugin.CAPABILITY is plugin.PLUGIN\n    assert callable(plugin.autoeject.inject_end_block)\n    # ``plugin.autoeject`` is the vendored package facade, not the web-app one.\n    assert isinstance(plugin.autoeject, types.ModuleType)\n    assert plugin.autoeject.__name__ == \"autoeject\"\n    assert \"vendor\" in str(plugin.autoeject.slicer.__file__)\n\n\ndef test_manifest_declares_the_spec_plugin_type():\n    text = Path(plugin.__file__).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    assert \"# /// script\" in text\n    assert \"# requires-python = \\\">=3.12\\\"\" in text\n    assert \"[tool.orcaslicer.plugin]\" in text\n    assert 'name = \"A1 AutoEject\"' in text\n    assert 'version = \"2.0.0\"' in text\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# P2: eject parameter config UI\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_default_config_matches_v1_eject_params():\n    config = plugin.get_default_config()\n    assert config == {\n        \"bed_heat_temp\": 60,\n        \"bed_heat_hold\": 60,\n        \"bed_cool_temp\": 25,\n        \"bed_cool_hold\": 120,\n        \"cycle_count\": 3,\n        \"gantry_push_z\": 50.0,\n        \"nozzle_push_z\": 1.0,\n        \"push_feed\": 6000,\n        \"max_layer_z_threshold\": 41.0,\n    }\n\n\ndef test_config_ui_marks_editable_and_readonly_fields():\n    ui = {field[\"name\"]: field for field in plugin.get_config_ui()}\n    assert {\n        \"bed_heat_temp\",\n        \"bed_heat_hold\",\n        \"bed_cool_temp\",\n        \"bed_cool_hold\",\n        \"cycle_count\",\n    } <= set(ui)\n    for name in (\"bed_heat_temp\", \"bed_heat_hold\", \"bed_cool_temp\", \"bed_cool_hold\"):\n        assert ui[name][\"editable\"] is True\n    assert ui[\"cycle_count\"][\"editable\"] is True\n    # Fixed push parameters must not be editable inputs.\n    assert ui[\"gantry_push_z\"][\"editable\"] is False\n    assert ui[\"gantry_push_z\"][\"readonly\"] is True\n    assert ui[\"push_feed\"][\"editable\"] is False\n    assert plugin.has_config_ui() is True\n\n\ndef test_save_config_persists_json_and_get_config_merges_defaults(\n    tmp_path, monkeypatch\n):\n    config_path = _isolate_config(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n    plugin.save_config(json.dumps({\"bed_heat_temp\": 75}))\n    assert config_path.exists()\n\n    config = plugin.get_config()\n    assert config[\"bed_heat_temp\"] == 75\n    assert config[\"bed_cool_temp\"] == 25\n    assert config[\"cycle_count\"] == 3\n    # Saved file is real JSON.\n    assert json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))[\"bed_heat_temp\"] == 75\n\n\ndef test_save_config_rejects_unknown_keys(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    _isolate_config(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        plugin.save_config({\"not_a_param\": 1})\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# P1: post-process eject block injection\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_execute_post_process_appends_eject_block(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    _isolate_config(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n    gcode_path = tmp_path / \"plate.gcode\"\n    gcode_path.write_text(PLAIN_GCODE, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    plugin.PLUGIN.execute(\n        Ctx(gcode_path, Step.psGCodePostProcess)\n    )\n\n    text = gcode_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    assert plugin.MACHINE_END_START in text\n    assert plugin.MACHINE_END_END in text\n    # v1 eject block markers are present too.\n    assert \"; --- ADDED: Special Cooling/Heating Sequence ---\" in text\n    assert \"M140 S60\" in text and \"M190 S60\" in text\n    assert \"M140 S25\" in text and \"M190 S25\" in text\n    assert \"G1 Y-0.5 F6000\" in text\n    # Default cycle_count is three.\n    assert text.count(\"M140 S60\") == 3\n    assert text.count(\"M190 S60\") == 3\n    # No unevaluated BambuStudio placeholders on executable lines.\n    for line in text.splitlines():\n        if not line.lstrip().startswith(\";\"):\n            assert \"{\" not in line and \"}\" not in line\n\n\ndef test_execute_uses_configured_temps_and_cycle_count(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    _isolate_config(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n    plugin.save_config(\n        json.dumps(\n            {\"bed_heat_temp\": 70, \"bed_cool_temp\": 25, \"cycle_count\": 3}\n        )\n    )\n    gcode_path = tmp_path / \"plate.gcode\"\n    gcode_path.write_text(PLAIN_GCODE, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    plugin.PLUGIN.execute(Ctx(gcode_path, Step.psGCodePostProcess))\n    text = gcode_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    assert text.count(\"M140 S70\") == 3\n    assert text.count(\"M190 S70\") == 3\n    assert text.count(\"M140 S25\") == 3\n    assert text.count(\"M190 S25\") == 3\n\n\ndef test_execute_ignores_other_steps(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    _isolate_config(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n    gcode_path = tmp_path / \"plate.gcode\"\n    original = \"G1 X0 Y0 F1000\\n\"\n    gcode_path.write_text(original, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    plugin.PLUGIN.execute(Ctx(gcode_path, Step.psGCodePreProcess))\n    assert gcode_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") == original\n\n\ndef test_execute_is_idempotent_on_a_second_pass(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    _isolate_config(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n    gcode_path = tmp_path / \"plate.gcode\"\n    gcode_path.write_text(PLAIN_GCODE, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    plugin.PLUGIN.execute(Ctx(gcode_path, Step.psGCodePostProcess))\n    once = gcode_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    plugin.PLUGIN.execute(Ctx(gcode_path, Step.psGCodePostProcess))\n    assert gcode_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") == once\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# F3 / item 4: check and the real pre-sliced fixture\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_40_mm_cube_passes_the_ejectability_check():\n    data = plugin.check(_stl(_centered_cube(40)))\n    assert data[\"verdict\"] == \"pass\"\n    assert \"reason\" in data\n    assert {rule[\"id\"] for rule in data[\"rules\"]} == {\n        \"max_layer_z\",\n        \"back_strip\",\n        \"bed_edge_margin\",\n        \"base_contact_area\",\n        \"tip_over_ratio\",\n    }\n\n\ndef test_post_process_real_fixture_with_n3_gives_three_push_moves(\n    tmp_path, monkeypatch\n):\n    _isolate_config(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n    gcode_path = tmp_path / \"real_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n    gcode_path.write_bytes(FIXTURE.read_bytes())\n\n    plugin.PLUGIN.execute(Ctx(gcode_path, Step.psGCodePostProcess, n=3))\n\n    entries = read_archive(gcode_path.read_bytes())\n    gcode = entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n    assert gcode.count(\"G1 Y-0.5 F6000\") == 3\n    recorded = entries[PLATE_MD5_NAME].decode(\"ascii\").strip()\n    assert recorded == hashlib.md5(entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME]).hexdigest().upper()\n    for line in gcode.splitlines():\n        if not line.lstrip().startswith(\";\"):\n            assert \"{\" not in line and \"}\" not in line\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# P3: vendored autoeject reuse\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_vendored_autoeject_is_used_and_not_reimplemented(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    _isolate_config(monkeypatch, tmp_path)\n    calls: list[tuple[object, object]] = []\n\n    def fake_inject(gcode, params):\n        calls.append((gcode, params))\n        return gcode\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(plugin.autoeject, \"inject_end_block\", fake_inject)\n    gcode_path = tmp_path / \"plate.gcode\"\n    gcode_path.write_text(PLAIN_GCODE, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    plugin.PLUGIN.execute(Ctx(gcode_path, Step.psGCodePostProcess))\n\n    assert len(calls) == 1\n    gcode_arg, params_arg = calls[0]\n    assert isinstance(gcode_arg, str)\n    assert params_arg[\"bed_heat_temp\"] == 60\n    assert set(plugin.DEFAULT_CONFIG) <= set(params_arg)\n\n\ndef test_vendored_build_end_block_defaults():\n    block = plugin.autoeject.build_end_block(plugin.get_default_config())\n    assert \"M140 S60\" in block\n    assert \"M190 S60\" in block\n    assert \"M140 S25\" in block\n    assert \"M190 S25\" in block\n    assert \"G1 Y-0.5 F6000\" in block\n    # Slicer placeholders are still present for inject_end_block to evaluate.\n    assert \"{max_layer_z + 0.5}\" in block\n\n\ndef test_vendored_check_is_the_real_autoeject_check():\n    assert plugin.autoeject.check is plugin.autoeject.ejectability.check\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Open questions are stubbed, not invented\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"function, argument\",\n    [\n        (plugin.check_from_context, None),\n        (plugin.locate_existing_end_block, None),\n        (plugin.start_print, None),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_open_questions_raise_not_implemented(function, argument):\n    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match=\"open question\"):\n        function(argument)\n\n\ndef test_repeat_print_job_is_stubbed():\n    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match=\"open question\"):\n        plugin.repeat_print_job(None, 3)\n"

    "originals": {
      "README.md": "# Auto-eject A1\n\nA web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 only** (256 \u00d7 256 mm bed). It turns one part into\na supervised loop of *N* prints, pushing each finished part off the bed with the\nFactorian Designs end block.\n\nThe Python core lives in `autoeject/` (no web imports); the FastAPI app and static\nUI live in `app/`; tests live in `tests/`.\n\n## Endpoints\n\n| Method | Path | Purpose |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| POST | `/api/check` | Measure an STL and return pass/warn/fail with reasons. |\n| POST | `/api/build` | Slice an STL (or patch a sliced `.gcode.3mf`) and return an N-copy `.gcode.3mf`. |\n| POST | `/api/simulate` | Replay the eject moves and report pushes, collisions and misses. |\n\nMultipart uploads use the field name `file`; the iteration count is the form\nfield `n`. Everything is synchronous and A1-only. A failing verdict blocks the\ndownload; a warning is shown but does not block.\n\n> **Supervised use only.** The heat/cool cycle does not prove that the part has\n> released. Inspect the bed and the exit path between copies; do not run the loop\n> unattended.\n\n## Run locally\n\nRequires Python 3.13 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).\n\n```bash\nuv sync\nuv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n```\n\nOpen <http://127.0.0.1:8000/> and upload an STL, or a pre-sliced `.gcode.3mf`.\nRun the tests with:\n\n```bash\nuv run pytest -q\n```\n\nTo slice in-process, point the app at a BambuStudio CLI and its installed A1\nprofiles:\n\n```bash\nexport BAMBU_CLI=/path/to/bambustudio/AppRun\nexport BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT=/path/to/bambustudio/resources/profiles/BBL\n```\n\nWithout `BAMBU_CLI` the STL path returns a synchronous error and directs you to\nthe pre-sliced fallback.\n\n### Export a sliced plate from Bambu Studio\n\n1. Open the part in Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1** printer and a\n   process/filament profile, and slice it.\n2. Use **File \u2192 Export \u2192 Export plate sliced file** (or the plate context menu\n   **Export plate sliced file\u2026**) and save the `.gcode.3mf`.\n3. Upload that file to the app. Only the stock end block, between\n   `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START` and `; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`, is replaced; the\n   `Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5` companion is recomputed.\n\n## Deploy\n\n`railway.toml` builds the `Dockerfile` and starts\n`uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`. The Dockerfile leaves the\nBambuStudio CLI install block commented out, so a plain image build does not\nsilently download an unpinned slicer.\n"
    }
  },

    "unified_diff": "--- a/README.md\n+++ b/README.md\n@@ -66,3 +66,58 @@\n `uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`. The Dockerfile leaves the\n BambuStudio CLI install block commented out, so a plain image build does not\n silently download an unpinned slicer.\n+\n+## OrcaSlicer plugin\n+\n+`orca_plugin/` is an OrcaSlicer 2.5 plugin (v2 spec) that appends the same v1\n+eject block to G-code exported by Orca. It is a `SlicingPipeline` capability and\n+uses only the documented `orca.slicing.SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase.execute`\n+hook; it never calls an undocumented Orca API. All eject decisions are delegated\n+to the vendored `autoeject` package in `orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject/` (the same\n+`check`, `build_end_block`, `inject_end_block` and `loop_3mf` code the web app\n+uses), so no eject rule or G-code template is duplicated.\n+\n+### Install\n+\n+1. Copy the whole `orca_plugin/` folder into OrcaSlicer's plugin directory so\n+   `autoeject_a1.py` and `vendor/` stay side by side. Orca reads the PEP 723\n+   manifest at the top of `orca_plugin/autoeject_a1.py`\n+   (`[tool.orcaslicer.plugin]`, `name = \"A1 AutoEject\"`, `version = \"2.0.0\"`).\n+2. OrcaSlicer must provide `orca.slicing` (Python 3.12 or newer). The plugin\n+   imports the vendored `autoeject` from `orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject`, so the\n+   folder is self-contained and can be installed as-is.\n+\n+### Use\n+\n+- The capability exposes `has_config_ui`, `get_config_ui`, `get_default_config`,\n+  `get_config` and `save_config`; config is stored as JSON.\n+- Editable: `bed_heat_temp` (60 \u00b0C), `bed_heat_hold` (60 s), `bed_cool_temp`\n+  (25 \u00b0C), `bed_cool_hold` (120 s) and `cycle_count` (3).\n+- Read-only (fixed v1 defaults): `gantry_push_z` (50 mm), `nozzle_push_z`\n+  (1 mm), `push_feed` (6000 mm/min) and `max_layer_z_threshold` (41 mm).\n+- At `orca.slicing.Step.psGCodePostProcess` the plugin reads `ctx.gcode_path`,\n+  builds the eject block from the config and edits the working file in place.\n+  A plain `.gcode` file gets the evaluated block appended between\n+  `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START` and `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_END`; a `.gcode.3mf`\n+  working file has the stock `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START` \u2026\n+  `; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END` span replaced and, when a copy count is supplied via\n+  `ctx.n`, is looped N times. A second pass is a no-op (idempotent marker).\n+- Run the tests with `uv run pytest -q`; `tests/test_orca_plugin.py` drives a\n+  fake `orca` module and the real vendored `autoeject`, including the real\n+  `fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf` at N = 3.\n+\n+### Known limits (v2 spec open questions)\n+\n+- The plugin cannot read STL bytes from Orca, so `check(stl_bytes)` cannot run\n+  inside the plugin (`check_from_context` raises `NotImplementedError`).\n+- No documented accessor exposes the printer's existing end G-code, so the\n+  plugin appends a new eject block instead of replacing the stock one\n+  (`locate_existing_end_block` raises `NotImplementedError`).\n+- No documented capability re-queues or repeats a job; the N-copy loop lives\n+  only in the web app's `/api/build` (`repeat_print_job` and `start_print` raise\n+  `NotImplementedError`).\n+- The plugin does not read or write `.gcode.3mf` as an Orca input/output; only\n+  the web app's fallback path handles pre-sliced archives.\n+- Whether `psGCodePostProcess` runs for a Bambu Lab A1 network upload, and how\n+  often it runs for export versus upload, is undocumented. The fixed push\n+  coordinates, safe Z and feed still need validation on a real A1.\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/orca_plugin/__init__.py\n@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@\n+\"\"\"OrcaSlicer plugin package for the AutoEject A1 SlicingPipeline capability.\n+\n+The installable plugin entry point is :mod:`orca_plugin.autoeject_a1`.\n+\"\"\"\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/orca_plugin/autoeject_a1.py\n@@ -0,0 +1,500 @@\n+# /// script\n+# requires-python = \">=3.12\"\n+# dependencies = []\n+#\n+# [tool.orcaslicer.plugin]\n+# name = \"A1 AutoEject\"\n+# description = \"Appends the v1 autoeject end block to exported A1 G-code.\"\n+# author = \"AutoEject A1 contributors\"\n+# version = \"2.0.0\"\n+# ///\n+\"\"\"OrcaSlicer 2.5 SlicingPipeline plugin for the Bambu Lab A1.\n+\n+The plugin uses only the capability type, hook and manifest fields named in the\n+v2 spec: a :class:`SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase` subclass whose ``execute``\n+runs at ``orca.slicing.Step.psGCodePostProcess``.  No undocumented Orca API is\n+called; the open questions from the spec are explicit ``NotImplementedError``\n+stubs.\n+\n+Every eject decision is delegated to the vendored ``autoeject`` package\n+(``orca_plugin/vendor/autoeject``).  This module contains no copied eject\n+rules, thresholds or G-code templates: it only orchestrates the vendored\n+``check``/``build_end_block``/``inject_end_block``/``loop_3mf`` functions.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import json\n+import os\n+import re\n+import sys\n+import types\n+from collections.abc import Mapping\n+from pathlib import Path\n+from typing import Any\n+\n+from orca.slicing import SlicingPipelineCapabilityBase, Step\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# Vendored autoeject import\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+_PLUGIN_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent\n+_VENDOR_DIR = _PLUGIN_DIR / \"vendor\"\n+\n+\n+def _load_vendored_autoeject() -> Any:\n+    \"\"\"Return the vendored autoeject package.\n+\n+    Package-style import is preferred (the repo and the installed plugin both\n+    keep ``vendor/autoeject`` beside this file).  For a single-file/standalone\n+    load the vendor directory is put on ``sys.path`` instead.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    try:\n+        from .vendor import autoeject as vendored\n+\n+        return vendored\n+    except ImportError:\n+        pass\n+    if str(_VENDOR_DIR) not in sys.path:\n+        sys.path.insert(0, str(_VENDOR_DIR))\n+    import autoeject as vendored  # type: ignore[no-redef]\n+\n+    return vendored\n+\n+\n+_vendored = _load_vendored_autoeject()\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# Public constants and configuration\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+#: Marker written into processed G-code so a second post-process pass is a no-op.\n+POSTPROCESS_MARKER = \"; --- AUTO_EJECT_A1 POSTPROCESSED ---\"\n+\n+#: Comment markers around the appended eject block for a plain G-code file.\n+MACHINE_END_START = \"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\"\n+MACHINE_END_END = \"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_END\"\n+\n+#: The nine v1 eject-block parameters.  Defaults match binding v1 exactly.\n+DEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = {\n+    \"bed_heat_temp\": 60,\n+    \"bed_heat_hold\": 60,\n+    \"bed_cool_temp\": 25,\n+    \"bed_cool_hold\": 120,\n+    \"cycle_count\": 3,\n+    \"gantry_push_z\": 50.0,\n+    \"nozzle_push_z\": 1.0,\n+    \"push_feed\": 6000,\n+    \"max_layer_z_threshold\": 41.0,\n+}\n+\n+#: Parameters the user may edit in the capability config UI.\n+EDITABLE_CONFIG = {\n+    \"bed_heat_temp\",\n+    \"bed_heat_hold\",\n+    \"bed_cool_temp\",\n+    \"bed_cool_hold\",\n+    \"cycle_count\",\n+}\n+\n+#: Optional plugin-only setting for the number of repeated print blocks.\n+_LOOP_KEY = \"loop_count\"\n+_ALLOWED_CONFIG = set(DEFAULT_CONFIG) | {_LOOP_KEY}\n+\n+#: JSON file used by get_config()/save_config().  Override with the\n+#: AUTO_EJECT_ORCA_CONFIG environment variable or by patching CONFIG_PATH.\n+CONFIG_PATH = Path(\n+    os.environ.get(\n+        \"AUTO_EJECT_ORCA_CONFIG\",\n+        str(Path.home() / \".config\" / \"autoeject\" / \"orca_plugin.json\"),\n+    )\n+)\n+\n+_PLATE_GCODE_NAME = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\"\n+_MAX_Z_RE = re.compile(r\"^;\\s*max_z_height\\s*:\\s*([-+0-9.eE]+)\\s*$\")\n+_XY_RE = re.compile(r\"^G1\\s+.*?\\bX([-+0-9.]+)\\b.*?\\bY([-+0-9.]+)\\b\")\n+\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# Config API named by the v2 spec\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def get_default_config() -> dict[str, Any]:\n+    \"\"\"Return a fresh copy of the v1 eject-block defaults.\"\"\"\n+    return dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)\n+\n+\n+def get_config_ui() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n+    \"\"\"Describe the capability config UI.\n+\n+    Temps, hold times and cycle count are editable; the fixed push parameters\n+    are returned read-only so a host cannot change them.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    fields = [\n+        (\"bed_heat_temp\", \"Bed heat temperature\", \"int\"),\n+        (\"bed_heat_hold\", \"Bed heat hold\", \"int\"),\n+        (\"bed_cool_temp\", \"Bed cool temperature\", \"int\"),\n+        (\"bed_cool_hold\", \"Bed cool hold\", \"int\"),\n+        (\"cycle_count\", \"Heat/cool cycles\", \"int\"),\n+        (\"gantry_push_z\", \"Gantry push Z (mm)\", \"float\"),\n+        (\"nozzle_push_z\", \"Nozzle push Z (mm)\", \"float\"),\n+        (\"push_feed\", \"Push feed (mm/min)\", \"int\"),\n+        (\"max_layer_z_threshold\", \"Max layer Z threshold (mm)\", \"float\"),\n+    ]\n+    return [\n+        {\n+            \"name\": name,\n+            \"label\": {sorted(unknown)[0]}\")\n+    return data\n+\n+\n+def get_config() -> dict[str, Any]:\n+    \"\"\"Return defaults merged with the persisted JSON config.\"\"\"\n+    config = get_default_config()\n+    config.update(_read_saved_config())\n+    return config\n+\n+\n+def _validate_loop_count(value: Any) -> int:\n+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):\n+        raise a mapping or a JSON object\")\n+    return config\n+\n+\n+def save_config(config: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n+    \"\"\"Validate and persist plugin configuration as JSON.\n+\n+    ``config`` may be a mapping or a JSON object string; omitted values keep\n+    their current values.  The eject parameters are validated by the real\n+    ``autoeject.build_end_block`` function, so this module never duplicates the\n+    v1 validation rules.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    mapping = _coerce_config(config)\n+    merged = get_config()\n+    if mapping is not None:\n+        unknown = set(mapping) - _ALLOWED_CONFIG\n+        if unknown:\n+            raise ValueError(f\"unknown plugin config key: {sorted(unknown)[0]}\")\n+        merged.update(mapping)\n+\n+    # Validate the eject parameters through the vendored autoeject itself.\n+    params = {key: merged[key] for key in DEFAULT_CONFIG}\n+    _vendored.build_end_block(params)\n+    if _LOOP_KEY in merged:\n+        _validate_loop_count(merged[_LOOP_KEY])\n+\n+    path = _config_path()\n+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    path.write_text(json.dumps(merged, indent=2) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    return merged\n+\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# Post-slice processing helpers (orchestration only; no eject logic)\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def _frame_values_for_plain_gcode(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n+    \"\"\"Use autoeject's parser; fall back to a lenient plain-G-code parse.\"\"\"\n+    try:\n+        return _vendored.slicer.frame_values(text, {})\n+    except ValueError:\n+        max_z: float | None = None\n+        center: list[float] | None = None\n+        for line in text.splitlines():\n+            stripped = line.strip()\n+            match = _MAX_Z_RE.match(stripped)\n+            if match and max_z is None:\n+                max_z = float(match.group(1))\n+                continue\n+            match = _XY_RE.match(stripped)\n+            if match and center is None:\n+                center = [float(match.group(1)), float(match.group(2))]\n+        # The eject block must never contain an unevaluated placeholder, so\n+        # missing frame values fall back to conservative safe defaults.\n+        return {\n+            \"max_layer_z\": 0.0 if max_z is None else max_z,\n+            \"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower\": [0.0, 0.0]\n+            if center is None\n+            else center,\n+            \"spiral_mode\": False,\n+            \"print_sequence\": \"by layer\",\n+        }\n+\n+\n+def _inject_end_block(gcode: str | bytes | bytearray, params: Any) -> str | bytes:\n+    \"\"\"Append (text) or replace-in-archive (``.gcode.3mf`` bytes) the eject block.\n+\n+    The block itself is always produced and evaluated by the vendored\n+    autoeject functions; this helper only chooses the plain-G-code or archive\n+    container and adds the idempotence marker.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if isinstance(gcode, (bytes, bytearray)):\n+        raw = bytes(gcode)\n+        entries = _vendored.slicer.read_archive(raw)\n+        if _PLATE_GCODE_NAME not in entries:\n+            raise ValueError(f\"archive has no {_PLATE_GCODE_NAME}\")\n+        text = entries[_PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n+        if POSTPROCESS_MARKER in text:\n+            return raw\n+        block = POSTPROCESS_MARKER + \"\\n\" + _vendored.build_end_block(params)\n+        return _vendored.inject_end_block(raw, block)\n+\n+    if not isinstance(gcode, str):\n+        raise ValueError(\"gcode must be text or .gcode.3mf bytes\")\n+    if POSTPROCESS_MARKER in gcode:\n+        return gcode\n+    values = _frame_values_for_plain_gcode(gcode)\n+    block = _vendored.build_end_block(params)\n+    evaluated = _vendored.evaluate_end_block(block, values)\n+    appended = \"\\n\".join(\n+        [POSTPROCESS_MARKER, MACHINE_END_START, evaluated, MACHINE_END_END, \"\"]\n+    )\n+    separator = \"\" if gcode.endswith(\"\\n\") else \"\\n\"\n+    return gcode + separator + appended\n+\n+\n+#: The autoeject functions the plugin calls.
